translations.idiomatic: a later edict extended the same tax relief to fugitives who returned on their own.

sentences.zh: 既而又與流民限，百日復業，蠲賦役，五年減舊賦十之八；

translations.literal: then again a limit was set with wandering people: within a hundred days resume occupation, remit levies and corvée, for five years reduce old levy by eight parts in ten;
translations.idiomatic: still later a deadline was imposed: fugitives who resumed their occupations within a hundred days were exempted from levies and corvée and enjoyed an eighty-percent reduction of the old tax for five years;

sentences.zh: 期盡不至，聽他人得耕。

translations.literal: when the term was exhausted and they did not arrive, others were permitted to obtain and till.
translations.idiomatic: if they failed to return when the term expired, others were permitted to cultivate the land.

sentences.zh: 至是，每下赦令，輒以招輯流亡、募人耕墾為言。

translations.literal: At this time, whenever amnesty edicts were issued, they invariably spoke of gathering wandering exiles and recruiting people to plow and open.
translations.idiomatic: By this time every amnesty edict routinely called for gathering fugitives and recruiting people to open new land.

sentences.zh: 民被災而流者，又復其蠲復，緩其期招之。

translations.literal: People afflicted by disaster and wandering—again their remissions were restored, the term relaxed to summon them.
translations.idiomatic: For commoners who fled because of disaster, remissions were renewed and deadlines extended to encourage their return.

sentences.zh: 詔諸州長吏、令、佐能勸民修陂池、溝洫之久廢者，及墾辟荒田、增稅二十萬已上，議賞；

translations.literal: An edict: prefectural chief administrators, magistrates, and aides able to urge the people to repair long-abandoned dikes, ponds, and ditches, or to open wasteland and increase tax by two hundred thousand and above—rewards were discussed;
translations.idiomatic: An edict promised rewards for prefectural administrators, magistrates, and aides who urged the people to restore long-abandoned dikes, ponds, and canals, or who opened wasteland and increased tax receipts by two hundred thousand cash or more;

sentences.zh: 監司能督責部吏經畫，賞亦如之。

translations.literal: supervisory commissioners able to supervise and compel subordinate clerks to plan and measure received rewards likewise.
translations.idiomatic: and supervisory commissioners who oversaw and directed their subordinates in such projects were to receive comparable rewards.

sentences.zh: 久之，天下生齒益蕃，辟田益廣。

translations.literal: After long time, throughout the realm living mouths increasingly flourished, opened fields increasingly broad.
translations.idiomatic: In time the population grew ever larger and cultivated land steadily expanded throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 獨京西唐、鄧間尚多曠土，入草莽者十八、九，或請徙戶實之，或議置屯田，或欲遂廢唐州為縣。

translations.literal: Only in the western capital circuit between Tang and Deng there still remained much vacant land; eight or nine tenths of it had gone into brush and weeds. Some requested relocating households to fill it, some proposed establishing military farm colonies, and some wished to abolish Tang Prefecture outright and reduce it to a county.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the western capital circuit between Tang and Deng did much land still lie vacant; eight or nine tenths of it had reverted to scrub and bramble. Some officials proposed relocating households to populate it, others urged establishing army farm colonies, and still others wanted to abolish Tang Prefecture entirely and reduce it to a county.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐中，唐守趙尚寬言土曠可辟，民希可招，而州不可廢。

translations.literal: During the Jiayou era, Tang Prefecture's prefect Zhao Shangkuan said the broad land could be opened, the sparse populace could be recruited, and the prefecture must not be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiayou era, Zhao Shangkuan, prefect of Tang, argued that the vacant soil could be reclaimed, scattered people could be drawn in, and the prefecture ought not to be abolished.

sentences.zh: 得漢邵信臣故陂渠遺跡而修復之，假牛犁、種食以誘耕者，勸課勞來。

translations.literal: He obtained the traces of the Han official Shao Xinchen's old reservoirs and canals and restored them, lending oxen, plows, and seed grain to entice cultivators, and both urged the agricultural levy and encouraged arrivals.
translations.idiomatic: He located the remains of the reservoir and canal works of the Han official Shao Xinchen and restored them, lending oxen, plows, and seed grain to draw farmers back, while both urging the field tax and welcoming new settlers.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，流民自歸及淮南、湖北之民至者二十餘戶；

translations.literal: After more than a year, displaced persons returned of their own accord, and people from Huainan and Hubei who arrived numbered more than twenty households;
translations.idiomatic: After little more than a year, refugees were returning on their own, and settlers from Huainan and Hubei added more than twenty households;

sentences.zh: 引水溉田幾數萬頃，變磽瘠為膏腴。

translations.literal: leading water to irrigate fields of nearly several tens of thousands of mu, changing barren poor soil into rich fertile land.
translations.idiomatic: He led water to irrigate nearly tens of thousands of mu of fields, turning thin, stony ground into rich farmland.

sentences.zh: 監司上其狀，三司使包拯亦以為言，遂留再任。

translations.literal: The supervisory commissioners reported his achievements; the Fiscal Commissioner Bao Zheng also spoke on his behalf, and so he was retained for a second term.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit inspectors memorialized his results, and the Fiscal Commissioner Bao Zheng spoke in his favor as well, so the court kept him in office for a second term.

sentences.zh: 治平中，歲滿當去。

translations.literal: In the Zhiping era his term was fulfilled and he was due to depart.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhiping his term expired and he was due to leave office.

sentences.zh: 英宗嘉其勤，且倚以興輯，特進一官，賜錢二十萬，復留再任。

translations.literal: Emperor Ying praised his diligence and, relying on him for revival and reorganization, specially advanced him one rank, granted two hundred thousand in cash, and again retained him for a second term.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ying commended his diligence and, counting on him to restore the region, specially promoted him one rank, granted him two hundred thousand cash, and again kept him in office for another term.

sentences.zh: 時患守令數易，詔察其有實課者增秩再任，而尚寬應詔為天下倡。

translations.literal: At the time the court was troubled that prefects and magistrates changed too often; an edict directed that those with genuine achievements in their duties be advanced in rank and retained, and Shangkuan answered the edict and became a model for the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The court was then concerned that local administrators changed too frequently; an edict ordered that officials with proven administrative records be promoted and retained, and Shangkuan answered the summons and became a model for the entire realm.

sentences.zh: 後太守高賦繼之，亦以能勸課被獎，留再任。

translations.literal: Later the grand prefect Gao Fu succeeded him; he too was rewarded for his ability to urge the agricultural levy and was retained for a second term.
translations.idiomatic: Later Grand Prefect Gao Fu succeeded him; he too was rewarded for effective promotion of agriculture and was kept on for a second term.

sentences.zh: 天下墾田：景德中，丁謂著《會計錄》雲，總得一百八十六萬餘頃。

translations.literal: Cultivated land throughout the realm: in the Jingde era, Ding Wei wrote in the 《Accounting Records》 that the total obtained was a little more than 1.86 million qing.
translations.idiomatic: Nationwide cultivated land: in the Jingde era, Ding Wei recorded in the 《Accounting Records》 a total of a little more than 1.86 million qing.

sentences.zh: 以是歲七百二十二萬餘戶計之，是四戶耕田一頃，繇是而知天下隱田多矣。

translations.literal: Calculating by this year's more than 7.22 million households, that is four households cultivating one qing; from this one knows that concealed fields throughout the realm were many.
translations.idiomatic: Counted against that year's more than 7.22 million households, this meant four households per qing of farmland--evidence of how much land throughout the realm went unreported.

sentences.zh: 又川峽、廣南之田，頃畝不備，第以五賦約之。

translations.literal: Moreover, in Sichuan, the gorges, and Guangnan the fields' qing and mu were not complete; they were reckoned only by rough fivefold tax estimates.
translations.idiomatic: In Sichuan, the gorge regions, and Guangnan moreover, acreage figures were incomplete and fields were reckoned only by rough five-fold tax equivalents.

sentences.zh: 至天聖中，國史則云：開寶末，墾田二百九十五萬二千三百二十頃六十畝；

translations.literal: By the Tiansheng era the National History then said: at the end of Kaibao, cultivated land 2,953,232 qing 60 mu;
translations.idiomatic: By Tiansheng the National History stated: at the end of Kaibao, cultivated land stood at 2,953,232 qing and 60 mu;

sentences.zh: 至道二年，三百一十二萬五千二百五十一頃二十五畝；

translations.literal: in the second year of Zhidao, 3,125,251 qing 25 mu;
translations.idiomatic: in the second year of Zhidao, 3,125,251 qing and 25 mu;

sentences.zh: 天禧五年，五百二十四萬七千五百八十四頃三十二畝。

translations.literal: in the fifth year of Tianxi, 5,247,584 qing 32 mu.
translations.idiomatic: and in the fifth year of Tianxi, 5,247,584 qing and 32 mu.

sentences.zh: 而開寶之數乃倍於景德，則謂之所錄，固未得其實。

translations.literal: Yet the Kaibao figure was actually double that of Jingde; what was called the recorded amount had plainly not obtained the reality.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Kaibao tally was double the Jingde figure, so what passed for an official record clearly did not reflect reality.

sentences.zh: 皇祐、治平，三司皆有《會計錄》，而皇祐中墾田二百二十八萬餘頃，治平中四百四十萬餘頃，其間相去不及二十年，而墾田之數增倍。

translations.literal: In Huangyou and Zhiping the Fiscal Commission each had the 《Accounting Records》, while in Huangyou cultivated land was a little more than 2.28 million qing and in Zhiping a little more than 4.4 million qing; the interval between them was less than twenty years, yet the figure for cultivated land doubled.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou and Zhiping the Fiscal Commission likewise kept the 《Accounting Records》; Huangyou reported a little more than 2.28 million qing of cultivated land and Zhiping a little more than 4.4 million--less than twenty years apart, yet the recorded acreage had doubled.

sentences.zh: 以治平數視天禧則猶不及，而敘《治平錄》者以謂此特計其賦租以知頃畝之數，而賦租所不如者十居其七。

translations.literal: Viewing the Zhiping figure against Tianxi it still fell short, and those who compiled the 《Zhiping Record》 said that this merely counted tax levies to know the number of qing and mu, while those not reached by tax levies were seven in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with Tianxi, the Zhiping figure still fell short; compilers of the 《Zhiping Record》 explained that it counted only taxed acreage, while seven tenths of cultivated land escaped the tax rolls.

sentences.zh: 率而計之，則天下墾田無慮三千餘萬頃。

translations.literal: Extrapolating and calculating, then cultivated land throughout the realm would be no less than a little more than 30 million qing.
translations.idiomatic: Extrapolated, nationwide cultivated land would be on the order of more than 30 million qing.

sentences.zh: 是時，累朝相承，重於擾民，未嚐窮按，故莫得其實，而廢田見於籍者猶四十八萬頃。

translations.literal: At that time, successive reigns on one another stressed avoiding disturbing the people and had never exhaustively investigated, so no one obtained the reality; yet abandoned fields appearing in the registers still amounted to 480,000 qing.
translations.idiomatic: Successive reigns had been reluctant to disturb the people and had never conducted a thorough survey, so the true total remained unknown; even so, abandoned fields still listed in the registers amounted to 480,000 qing.

sentences.zh: 治平四年，詔曰：“歲比不登，今春時雨，農民桑蠶、穀麥，眾作勤勞，一歲之功，並在此時。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiping an edict said: "Year after year harvests have not been good; now in spring the timely rains have come. For the farmers, silkworms, grain, and wheat--the myriad tasks demand strenuous toil; the year's entire achievement rests in this season.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhiping an edict declared: "Harvests have failed year after year; now timely spring rains have come. Sericulture, grain, and wheat demand the farmers' utmost labor--the whole year's work turns on this season.

sentences.zh: 其委安撫、轉運司敕戒州縣吏，省事息民，無奪其時。

translations.literal: Let the Pacification and Transport commissioners admonish prefectural and county officials to reduce affairs and give the people rest, and not seize their season.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification and Transport commissioners were to admonish prefectural and county officials to lighten their burdens and avoid seizing the farmers' season.

sentences.zh: ”“諸路逃田三十年者除其稅十四，四十年以上十五，五十年以上六分，百年以上七分；

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. "Throughout the circuits, for abandoned fields of thirty years remove fourteen parts of their tax; forty years and above fifteen; fifty years and above six tenths; a hundred years and above seven tenths;
translations.idiomatic: "Throughout the circuits, on abandoned land, tax reductions were set: fourteen parts remitted after thirty years; after forty years, fifteen parts; after fifty years, six tenths; after a hundred years, seven tenths;

sentences.zh: 佃及十年輸五分，二十年輸七分，著為令。

translations.literal: for tenants reaching ten years pay five tenths; twenty years pay seven tenths; established as statute.
translations.idiomatic: for tenants who had cultivated land ten years, tax was set at five tenths; at twenty years, seven tenths--enacted as permanent statute.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙寧元年，襄州宜城令朱紘復修水渠，溉田六千頃，詔遷一官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Shenzong's Xining, Xiang Prefecture Yicheng magistrate Zhu Hong again restored the water channel, irrigating six thousand qing of fields; an edict advanced him one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shenzong's Xining reign, Zhu Hong, magistrate of Yicheng in Xiang Prefecture, restored the irrigation channel and watered six thousand qing of fields; the court promoted him one rank.

sentences.zh: 權京西轉運使謝景溫言：“在法，請田戶五年內科役皆免。

translations.literal: Acting Transport Commissioner for the western capital circuit Xie Jingwen said: "By law, petitioning-field households within five years are all exempt from corvee levies.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Transport Commissioner for the western capital circuit Xie Jingwen memorialized: "Under law, tenants who petitioned for fields are exempt from all corvee levies for five years.

sentences.zh: 貶汝州四縣客戶，不一二年便為舊戶糾抉，與之同役，因此即又逃竄，田土荒萊。

translations.literal: In the four counties of Run Prefecture, guest households within one or two years were seized by old households for mutual imposition and made to share corvee; because of this they again fled, and fields lay waste and overgrown.
translations.idiomatic: In the four counties of Run Prefecture, newcomers were within a year or two seized by established households for mutual corvee imposition and subjected to the same labor obligations, whereupon they fled again and the land reverted to waste.

sentences.zh: 欲乞置墾田務，差官專領，籍四縣荒田，召人請射。

translations.literal: He wished to request establishing a Reclamation Office, dispatching officials to oversee exclusively, registering the four counties' waste fields, and summoning people to petition for allotment.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to establish a reclamation bureau with dedicated officials, register all abandoned land in the four counties, and invite people to petition for allotments.

sentences.zh: 更不以其人隸屬諸縣版籍，須五年乃撥附，則五年內自無差科。

translations.literal: Further, such persons would not be placed under the various counties' registers; only after five years would they be attached, so that within five years naturally there would be no levies or corvee.
translations.idiomatic: Tenant households would not be entered on county registers until after five years, so no levies or corvee would fall on them during that period.

sentences.zh: 如招及千戶以上者，優獎。

translations.literal: If recruitment reached a thousand households and above, generous reward.
translations.idiomatic: Recruiting a thousand households or more would earn special rewards.

sentences.zh: ”詔不置務，餘從所請。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict said: do not establish the office; the rest followed his request.
translations.idiomatic: The court declined to create the bureau but approved the rest of his proposal.

sentences.zh: 明年，分遣諸路常平官，使專領農田水利。

translations.literal: The next year, envoys for the Ever-Normal Granaries were dispatched on each circuit to have them oversee agriculture and water conservancy exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the court dispatched Ever-Normal Granary agents on each circuit to take charge of farming and irrigation.

sentences.zh: 吏民能知土地種植之法，陂塘、圩垾、堤堰、溝洫利害者，皆得自言；

translations.literal: Officials and commoners who knew methods of land planting, and the benefits and harms of reservoirs, polders, dikes, and ditches, might all speak for themselves;
translations.idiomatic: Officials and commoners who understood crop methods or the advantages and drawbacks of reservoirs, polders, dikes, and canals could all submit proposals;

sentences.zh: 行之有效，隨功利大小酬賞。

translations.literal: if implementation was effective, reward according to the size of the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: successful projects would be rewarded in proportion to their benefit.

sentences.zh: 民占荒逃田若歸業者，責相保任，逃稅者保任為輸之。

translations.literal: Commoners who occupied abandoned fleeing fields or returned to their occupations were required to guarantee one another; those who fled taxes, the guarantors paid on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Those who reclaimed abandoned land or resumed farming had to provide mutual guarantees, and guarantors were liable for any tax evasion.

sentences.zh: 已行新法縣分，田土頃畝、川港陂塘之類，令、佐受代，具墾辟開修之數授諸代者，令照籍有實乃代。

translations.literal: In counties where the new laws had been implemented, when magistrates and assistants were relieved, they were to hand over the numbers of reclaimed and opened fields, streams, harbors, and reservoirs to their successors, who might replace them only when the register matched reality.
translations.idiomatic: In counties under the new laws, outgoing magistrates and assistants had to transfer tallies of reclaimed acreage and of streams, harbors, and reservoirs to their successors, who could take office only after verifying the records.

sentences.zh: 中書議勸民栽桑。

translations.literal: The Secretariat deliberated on urging the people to plant mulberry.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat debated measures to encourage mulberry planting.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：“農桑，衣食之本。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Agriculture and sericulture are the root of clothing and food.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Farming and sericulture are the foundation of clothing and food.

sentences.zh: 民不敢自力者，正以州縣約以為貲，升其戶等耳。

translations.literal: The reason the people dare not exert themselves is precisely that prefectures and counties treat it as wealth and raise their household grades.
translations.idiomatic: The people dare not plant more because prefectures and counties count it as wealth and raise their household grades accordingly.

sentences.zh: 宜申條禁。

translations.literal: It is fitting to proclaim the prohibitory articles.
translations.idiomatic: The prohibitions should be reiterated clearly.

sentences.zh: ”於是司農寺諸立法，先行之開封，視可行，頒於天下。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon the Directorate of Agriculture drafted laws, first implementing them in Kaifeng; when they were seen to be feasible, they were promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Directorate of Agriculture drafted regulations, piloted them in Kaifeng, and when they proved workable issued them nationwide.

sentences.zh: 民種桑柘毋得增賦。

translations.literal: When the people planted mulberry and paper-mulberry, no additional tax was to be imposed.
translations.idiomatic: Planting mulberry and paper-mulberry would not increase a household's tax assessment.

sentences.zh: 安肅廣信順安軍、保州，令民即其地植桑榆或所宜木，因可限閡戎馬。

translations.literal: In the Ansu, Guangxin, Shun'an Army, and Bao Prefecture, the people were ordered to plant mulberry, elm, or trees suited to the soil on the spot, thereby blocking enemy horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Ansu, Guangxin, Shun'an Army, and Bao Prefecture, people were ordered to plant mulberry, elm, or locally suitable trees to obstruct enemy cavalry.

sentences.zh: 官計其活茂多寡，得差減在戶租數；

translations.literal: The government reckoned how many lived and flourished and, according to the amount, granted proportional reduction of the household's rent quota;
translations.idiomatic: Officials tallied surviving growth and granted proportional rent reductions;

sentences.zh: 活不及數者罰，責之補種。

translations.literal: those whose living growth did not reach the quota were fined and ordered to make up the planting.
translations.idiomatic: those falling short were fined and ordered to replant.

sentences.zh: 興修水利田，起熙寧三年至九年，府界及諸路凡一萬七百九十三處，為田三十六萬一千一百七十八頃有奇。

translations.literal: For fields where water conservancy was developed, from the third year of Xining through the ninth, in the capital district and on the circuits altogether 10,793 places, yielding 361,178 qing and a fraction of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Waterworks carried out from the third through the ninth year of Xining reached 10,793 projects in the capital district and on the circuits, irrigating 361,178 qing and a fraction of farmland.

sentences.zh: 神宗元豐元年，詔開廢田，興水利，民力不能給役者，貸以常平錢穀，京西南路流民買耕牛者免征。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shenzong's Yuanfeng, an edict opened waste fields and developed water conservancy; where the people's strength could not supply corvee, Ever-Normal money and grain were lent; on the southwestern capital circuit, displaced persons buying plow oxen were exempted from tax.
translations.idiomatic: In Shenzong's first Yuanfeng year an edict promoted opening waste land and building irrigation; where peasants could not bear corvee, Ever-Normal funds and grain were lent, and on the southwestern capital circuit refugees buying draft oxen were exempted from tax.

sentences.zh: 五年，都水使者範三淵奏：“自大名抵乾寧，跨十五州，河徙地凡七千頃，乞募人耕種。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Director of Waterways Fan Sanyuan memorialized: "From Daming to Qianning, spanning fifteen prefectures, where the river shifted there were 7,000 qing of land; I beg to recruit people to cultivate it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Director of Waterways Fan Sanyuan reported: "From Daming to Qianning, across fifteen prefectures, river shifts had left some seven thousand qing of land; I ask permission to recruit cultivators.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 哲宗即位，宣仁太后臨朝，首起司馬光為門下侍郎，委之以政。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong took the throne, Empress Dowager Xuanren held court and first recalled Sima Guang as Vice Director of the Secretariat, entrusting him with government.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong ascended the throne, Empress Dowager Xuanren regented and first recalled Sima Guang as Vice Director of the Secretariat, entrusting him with affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 詔天下臣民皆得以封事言民間疾苦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that all officials and commoners throughout the realm might submit sealed memorials on the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed officials and commoners throughout the realm to submit sealed memorials describing popular hardships.

sentences.zh: 光抗疏曰：“四民之中，惟農最苦，寒耕熱耘，沾體塗足，戴日而作，戴星而息；

translations.literal: Guang submitted a resolute memorial saying: "Among the four classes of people, only farmers suffer most--plowing in cold, hoeing in heat, body soaked and feet smeared, working by day and resting by starlight;
translations.idiomatic: Guang submitted a forthright memorial: "Of the four orders of society, farmers suffer most--plowing in cold and hoeing in heat, bodies drenched and feet mired, laboring from sunup and resting only after the stars appear;

sentences.zh: 蠶婦治繭、績麻、紡緯，縷縷而積之，寸寸而成之，其勤極矣。

translations.literal: silkworm wives tending cocoons, hemp, and weaving, thread by thread accumulating, inch by inch completing--their toil is extreme.
translations.idiomatic: women tend cocoons, hemp, and weaving, thread by thread and inch by inch--their labor is beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 而又水旱、霜雹、蝗蜮間為之災，幸而收成，公私之債，交爭互奪。

translations.literal: Yet flood, drought, frost, hail, and locusts intermittently become disasters for them; if by chance there is harvest, public and private debts contend and seize.
translations.idiomatic: Then flood, drought, frost, hail, and locusts strike in turn; even when there is a harvest, public and private creditors seize what they can.

sentences.zh: 穀未離場，帛未下機，已非己有，所食者糠乞而不足，所衣者綈褐而不完。

translations.literal: Before grain leaves the threshing floor or silk leaves the loom, it is already not their own; what they eat is chaff begging and still insufficient, what they wear is coarse cloth and still incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: Before grain leaves the threshing floor or silk leaves the loom, it is no longer theirs; they eat chaff and still go hungry, they wear coarse cloth and still go threadbare.

sentences.zh: 直以世服田畝，不知舍此之外有何可生之路耳。

translations.literal: They simply take farming fields as their lifelong garment and know no other path by which to live beyond this.
translations.idiomatic: They know only the plow and have no other way to live.

sentences.zh: 而況聚斂之臣，於租稅之外，巧取百端，以邀功賞。

translations.literal: Moreover, revenue-pressing officials, beyond rent and tax, ingeniously seize in a hundred ways to invite merit rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile revenue officials, beyond rent and tax, contrive a hundred exactions to win merit and rewards.

sentences.zh: 青苗則強散重斂，給陳納新；

translations.literal: Green Sprouts forcibly dispersed heavy levies, giving stale grain and collecting new;
translations.idiomatic: The Green Sprouts policy forced heavy disbursements and collected repayment in fresh grain;

sentences.zh: 免役則刻剝窮民，收養浮食；

translations.literal: Service Exemption carved the poor people and collected idle eaters;
translations.idiomatic: the Service Exemption system gouged the poor while enrolling idlers;

sentences.zh: 保甲則勞於非業之作；

translations.literal: Baojia labored at non-agricultural tasks;
translations.idiomatic: Baojia conscription diverted labor to non-farming work;

sentences.zh: 保馬則困於無益之費，可不念哉！

translations.literal: Baoma distressed them with useless expenses--should this not be considered!
translations.idiomatic: and the Horse Breeding policy burdened them with useless expense--can this be ignored?

sentences.zh: 今者浚發德音，使畎畝之民得上封事。

translations.literal: Now you have issued a virtuous pronouncement, allowing farmers in the fields to submit sealed memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty has issued a benevolent edict, allowing farmers to submit sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 雖其言辭鄙雜，皆身受實患，直貢其誠，不可忽也。

translations.literal: Although their words are rustic and mixed, all bear real afflictions they have suffered; they directly offer their sincerity and must not be neglected.
translations.idiomatic: Though their language is rough, they speak from real suffering and offer honest testimony that must not be dismissed.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 初，熙寧六年，立法勸民栽桑，有不趨令，則仿屋粟、裏布為之罰。

translations.literal: Initially, in the sixth year of Xining, a law was enacted urging the people to plant mulberry; those who did not hasten to the order were fined on the model of house-grain and lane-cloth levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Xining a law had urged mulberry planting, fining those who lagged on the model of house-grain and lane-cloth levies.

sentences.zh: 然長民之吏不能究宣德意，民以為病。

translations.literal: Yet the officials who governed the people could not thoroughly carry out the court's intent, and the people regarded it as a affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Yet local administrators failed to implement the court's intent, and the people found the policy burdensome.

sentences.zh: 至是，楚丘民胡昌等言其不便，詔罷之，且蠲所負罰金。

translations.literal: At this time the people of Chuqiu, Hu Chang and others, spoke of its inconvenience; an edict abolished it and also remitted fines owed.
translations.idiomatic: Then Hu Chang of Chuqiu and others protested its hardships; the court abolished the policy and remitted outstanding fines.

sentences.zh: 興平縣抑民田為牧地，民亦自言，詔悉還之。

translations.literal: Xingping County suppressed people's fields into pastureland; the people also spoke for themselves, and an edict fully returned them.
translations.idiomatic: Xingping County had seized farmland for pasture; when the people appealed, an edict ordered the land fully restored.

sentences.zh: 元祐四年，詔：“瀕河州縣，積水冒田。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, an edict said: "In prefectures and counties along the river, accumulated water flooded fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanyou an edict declared: "Along the Yellow River, standing water was drowning fields.

sentences.zh: 在任官能為民經畫疏導溝畎，退出良田自百頃至千頃，第賞。

translations.literal: Officials in office who could plan and guide drainage ditches for the people and recover good fields from one hundred to one thousand qing would be rewarded by grade.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who planned drainage and restored good fields in amounts from one hundred to one thousand qing would be rewarded by rank.

sentences.zh: 崇寧中，廣東南路轉運判官王覺，以開辟荒田幾及萬頃，詔遷一官。

translations.literal: During Chongning, Wang Jue, transport intendant for the Guangdong and Guangnan South circuit, for opening waste fields of nearly ten thousand qing received an edict advancing him one rank.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongning, Wang Jue, transport intendant for Guangdong and southern Guangnan, was promoted one rank for reclaiming nearly ten thousand qing of waste land.

sentences.zh: 其後，知州、部使者以能課民種桑棗者，率優其第秩焉。

translations.literal: Thereafter, prefects and circuit commissioners who could urge the people to plant mulberry and jujube were generally given preferential advancement in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter prefects and circuit commissioners who effectively promoted mulberry and jujube planting were routinely advanced in rank.

sentences.zh: 政和六年，立管幹圩岸、圍岸官法，在官三年，無隳損堙塞者賞之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenghe, a law was established for officials managing polder banks and ring-banks; after three years in office, those with no collapse, damage, or silting were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhenghe regulations were set for officials in charge of polder and ring dikes; after three years without collapse, damage, or silting they were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 京畿提點刑獄王本言：“前任提舉常平，根括諸縣天荒瘠鹵地一萬二千餘頃入稻田務，已佃者五千三百餘頃，尚慮令、佐不肯究心。

translations.literal: Wang Ben, judicial intendant for the capital region, said: "In my former post as Ever-Normal intendant, I inventoried more than twelve thousand qing of heaven-abandoned barren and saline land in the various counties into the rice-field office; already tenanted were more than five thousand three hundred qing, yet I still feared that magistrates and assistants would not devote themselves wholeheartedly.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ben, judicial intendant for the capital region, reported: "As Ever-Normal intendant I had inventoried more than twelve thousand qing of abandoned barren and saline land in the counties for the rice-field office; more than five thousand three hundred qing were already tenanted, yet I still feared magistrates would not press the work.

sentences.zh: ”詔比開墾堿地格推賞。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict ordered rewards by the standard for opening saline-alkali land.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered rewards under the standard for reclaiming saline-alkali land.

sentences.zh: 平江府興修圍田二千餘頃，令、佐而下以差減磨勘年。

translations.literal: In Pingjiang Prefecture more than two thousand qing of ring-fields were developed; magistrates, assistants, and subordinates had years deducted from their merit review according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang Prefecture developed more than two thousand qing of ring dikes; magistrates and subordinates received reductions in merit-review years by rank.

sentences.zh: 八年，權淮南、江、浙、荊湖製置發運使任諒奏：“高郵軍有逃田四百四十六頃，楚州九百七十四頃，泰州五百七十二頃，平江府四百九十七頃，以六路計之，何可勝數。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Acting Commissioner for Transport and Supply on the Huainan, Jiang, Zhe, and Jing-Hu circuits Ren Liang memorialized: "Gaoyou Army has 446 qing of abandoned fields, Chuzhou 974 qing, Taizhou 572 qing, Pingjiang Prefecture 497 qing; reckoned across the six circuits, the number is beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Acting Commissioner for Transport and Supply Ren Liang reported: "Gaoyou Army has 446 qing of abandoned land, Chuzhou 974, Taizhou 572, Pingjiang 497; across the six circuits the total is incalculable.

sentences.zh: 欲諸縣專選官按籍根括。

translations.literal: I wish that each county specially select an official to investigate the registers and inventory.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that each county appoint a dedicated officer to audit the registers.

sentences.zh: ”詔逃田可去委縣丞，無丞處委他官，餘並從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict said abandoned fields might be delegated to assistant magistrates; where there was no assistant, another official; the rest all followed his request.
translations.idiomatic: The court assigned abandoned land to assistant magistrates, or to other officials where no assistant existed, and approved the remainder of his plan.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，臣僚上言：“監司、守令官帶勸農，莫副上意，欲立四證驗之：按田萊荒治之跡，較戶產登降之籍，驗米穀貴賤之價，考租賦盈虧之數。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe, a courtier memorialized: "Circuit commissioners and prefects and magistrates bear the title of urging agriculture, yet do not fulfill the sovereign's intent; I wish to establish four proofs for verification: examine traces of waste fields reclaimed, compare household registers of rising and falling production, verify prices of grain cheap and dear, and investigate numbers of rent and tax surplus and deficit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuanhe a courtier memorialized: "Circuit commissioners, prefects, and magistrates hold the charge of promoting agriculture yet fall short of the throne's intent; I propose four proofs: traces of reclaiming waste land, household registers showing rising or falling yields, market prices of grain, and records of rent surplus or deficit.

sentences.zh: 四證具，則其實著矣。

translations.literal: When the four proofs are complete, then the reality is manifest.
translations.idiomatic: When all four proofs align, performance will be plain.

sentences.zh: ”命中書審定取旨。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Ordered the Secretariat to deliberate and obtain the imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat was ordered to deliberate and report for imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔：“江東轉運司根括到逃田一百六十頃一十六畝，兩浙根括到四百五十六頃，召人出租，專充今年增屯戍兵衣糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict said: "The Jiangdong Transport Commission inventoried 160 qing 16 mu of abandoned fields; the two Zhe circuits inventoried 456 qing; people were summoned to rent them, devoted exclusively to this year's added garrison soldiers' clothing and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year an edict stated: "Jiangdong Transport inventoried 160 qing and 16 mu of abandoned land; the two Zhe circuits 456 qing; tenants were sought, with rents devoted solely to added garrison clothing and grain this year.

sentences.zh: ”初，政和中，品官限田，一品百頃，以差降殺，至九品為十畝；

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Initially, during Zhenghe, ranked officials' field limits: first rank one hundred qing, decreasing by grades, down to ninth rank ten mu;
translations.idiomatic: Initially, during Zhenghe, field limits were set for ranked officials: first rank one hundred qing, decreasing by grade to ten mu for the ninth rank;

sentences.zh: 限外之數，並同編戶差科。

translations.literal: amounts beyond the limit were all taxed like registered households.
translations.idiomatic: holdings above the limit were taxed like ordinary households.

sentences.zh: 七年，又詔：“內外宮觀舍置田，在京不得過五十頃，在外不得過三十頃，不免科差、徭役、支移。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, another edict said: "Fields set aside for inner and outer palace and temple establishments: in the capital not to exceed fifty qing, outside not to exceed thirty qing, not exempt from levies, corvee, or transport surcharges.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year another edict capped endowment fields for palace and temple establishments at fifty qing in the capital and thirty outside, without exemption from levies, corvee, or transport surcharges.

sentences.zh: 雖奉御筆，許執奏不行。

translations.literal: Even if an imperial brush edict was received, memorialization and refusal to implement were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Even imperial brush edicts could be memorialized against and refused.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年五月，高宗即位，命有司招誘農民，歸業者振貸之，蠲欠租，免耕牛稅。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Jianyan, Gaozong took the throne and ordered the relevant offices to entice farmers; those returning to their occupations were given relief loans, arrears of rent remitted, and plow-ox tax exempted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first Jianyan year, when Gaozong took the throne, he ordered officials to entice farmers back; returnees received relief loans, rent arrears were remitted, and plow-ox tax was waived.

sentences.zh: 三年，廣州州學教授林勳獻《本政書》十三篇，大略謂：“國朝兵農之政，大抵因唐末之故。

translations.literal: In the third year, Lin Xun, professor at Guangzhou Prefectural School, presented thirteen chapters of the 《Basic Policies》, saying in outline: "Our dynasty's policy of soldiers and farmers largely followed the conditions at the end of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Lin Xun, professor at the Guangzhou prefectural school, submitted thirteen chapters of the 《Basic Policies》, arguing in outline that "the dynasty's civil-military policy largely followed late Tang conditions.

sentences.zh: 今農貧而多失職，兵驕而不可用，是以饑民竄卒，類為盜賊。

translations.literal: Now farmers are poor and many lose their occupations; soldiers are arrogant and cannot be used; thus hungry people and deserters mostly become bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Farmers are now poor and many lack livelihood; soldiers are insubordinate and unusable; hungry peasants and deserters alike turn to banditry.

sentences.zh: 宜仿古井田之製，使民一夫占田五十畝，其羨田之家毋得市田；

translations.literal: It is fitting to imitate the ancient well-field system, making each man occupy fifty mu of fields; households with surplus land must not buy fields;
translations.idiomatic: He proposed reviving the well-field model, allotting fifty mu per adult male; households with surplus land must not buy more;

sentences.zh: 其無田與遊惰末作者，皆使為隸農，以耕田之羨者。

translations.literal: those without fields and idle wanderers at the end of trades should all be made dependent farmers, cultivating the surplus fields of those who farm.
translations.idiomatic: the landless and idle would become dependent farmers working surplus holdings.

sentences.zh: 雜紐錢穀，以為什一之稅。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous bolted money and grain would serve as the one-tenth tax.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous bolted payments in money and grain would constitute the tithe.

sentences.zh: 本朝二稅之數，視唐增至七倍。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's two-tax figure is seven times Tang when viewed.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty's two-tax burden is seven times that of Tang.

sentences.zh: 今本政之製，每十六夫為一井，提封百里，為三千四百井，率稅米五萬一千斛，錢萬二千緡。

translations.literal: Under the present Basic Policies system, every sixteen husbands form one well; within a hundred-li demesne are 3,400 wells, yielding in tax 51,000 hu of rice and twelve thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Under his system, sixteen adult males would form one well; within a hundred-li demesne would be 3,400 wells, yielding 51,000 hu of rice and twelve thousand strings of cash in tax.

sentences.zh: 每井賦二兵一馬，率為兵六千八百人，馬三千四百匹。

translations.literal: Each well supplies tax for two soldiers and one horse, yielding in all 6,800 soldiers and 3,400 horses.
translations.idiomatic: Each well would support two soldiers and one horse in tax, totaling 6,800 soldiers and 3,400 horses.

sentences.zh: （此方百里之縣所出賦稅之數。）〉

translations.literal: (The tax yields of a hundred-li county under this scheme.) — closing section marker.〉
translations.idiomatic: (Tax yields of a hundred-li county under this scheme.) — end of section note.〉

sentences.zh: 歲取五之一以為上番之額，以給征役；

translations.literal: Each year one-fifth would be taken as the quota for the upper rotation, to supply military campaigns;
translations.idiomatic: One-fifth of the levy each year would fund the upper rotation for campaigns;

sentences.zh: 無事則又分為四番，以直官府，以給守衛。

translations.literal: in peacetime it would again be divided into four rotations, to staff government offices and supply guards.
translations.idiomatic: in peacetime it would split into four rotations to staff offices and guards.

sentences.zh: 是民凡三十五年，而役始一遍也。

translations.literal: Thus the people would complete one full round of service only once every thirty-five years.
translations.idiomatic: The people would thus serve one full cycle only once every thirty-five years.

sentences.zh: 悉上則歲食米萬九千餘斛，錢三千六百餘緡，無事則減四分之三，皆以一同之租稅供之。

translations.literal: If levied in full, annual consumption would exceed nineteen thousand hu of rice and more than 3,600 strings of cash; in peacetime this would be reduced by three-fourths, all supplied from a single uniform land tax.
translations.idiomatic: At full levy, annual consumption would exceed 19,000 hu of rice and 3,600 strings of cash; in peacetime three-fourths would be cut, all from one uniform land tax.

sentences.zh: 匹婦之貢，絹三尺，綿一兩，百里之縣，歲收絹四千餘匹，綿三千四百斤；

translations.literal: Each wife's tribute would be three chi of silk and one liang of cotton; a hundred-li county would collect more than 4,000 bolts of silk and 3,400 jin of cotton per year;
translations.idiomatic: Each wife would owe three chi of silk and one liang of cotton; a hundred-li county would gather more than 4,000 bolts of silk and 3,400 jin of cotton yearly;

sentences.zh: 非蠶鄉則布六尺，麻二兩，所收視綿絹倍之。

translations.literal: in non-sericulture districts, six chi of cloth and two liang of hemp, with collections double those of cotton and silk.
translations.idiomatic: non-sericulture districts would owe six chi of cloth and two liang of hemp, with collections twice the silk and cotton totals.

sentences.zh: 行之十年，則民之口算，官之酒酤，與凡茶、鹽、香、礬之榷，皆可弛以予民。

translations.literal: After ten years of implementation, household poll taxes, government wine monopolies, and all monopolies on tea, salt, incense, and alum could be relaxed and returned to the people.
translations.idiomatic: After ten years, poll taxes, wine monopolies, and monopolies on tea, salt, incense, and alum could all be lifted for the people.

sentences.zh: ”其說甚備。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. His exposition was very thorough.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark. His argument was remarkably thorough.

sentences.zh: 尋以勳為桂州節度掌書記。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Lin Xun was appointed secretary on the staff of the Guizhou military commission.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Xun was soon made secretary on the Guizhou military commission staff.

sentences.zh: 建炎以來，內外用兵，所在多逃絕之田。

translations.literal: Since Jianyan, with warfare at home and abroad, abandoned and forfeited fields were widespread.
translations.idiomatic: Since Jianyan, war at home and abroad had left many fields abandoned or forfeited.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年四月，詔兩浙路收買牛具，貸淮東人戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second Shaoxing year, an edict ordered the Two Zhe circuits to purchase oxen and implements and lend them to households in eastern Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Shaoxing 2, an edict had the Two Zhe circuits buy oxen and tools and lend them to eastern Huai households.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔：知興國軍王、知永興縣陳升率先奉詔誘民墾田，各增一秩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month an edict said: Wang, prefect of Xingguo Army, and Chen Sheng, magistrate of Yongxing County, who took the lead in enticing people to reclaim fields under the edict, were each promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month an edict promoted Wang, prefect of Xingguo Army, and Chen Sheng, magistrate of Yongxing County, one rank each for leading the effort to entice reclamation.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，戶部言：“百姓棄產，已詔二年外許人請射，十年內雖已請射及充職田者，並聽歸業。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year the Ministry of Revenue said: "When commoners abandon their holdings, it has already been decreed that after two years others may apply to cultivate them; within ten years, even if already applied for or assigned as official fields, all may return to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 3 the Ministry of Revenue said: "Abandoned holdings may after two years be applied for by others; within ten years, even fields already applied for or assigned as official duty land must allow return to the original holders.

sentences.zh: 孤幼及親屬應得財產者，守令驗實給還，冒占者論如律。

translations.literal: Orphans and kin entitled to property should have the prefect and magistrate verify and restore it; unlawful seizure would be punished under law.
translations.idiomatic: Orphans and relatives with property claims were to have prefects and magistrates verify and restore holdings; unlawful seizure would be prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 州縣奉行不虔，監司按劾。

translations.literal: Where prefectures and counties did not carry this out diligently, supervisory commissioners would investigate and impeach.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties that failed to enforce this diligently would face investigation by circuit commissioners.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark. The court approved.

sentences.zh: （先是，臣僚言：“近詔州縣拘籍被虜百姓稅賦，而苛酷之吏不考其實，其間有父母被虜兒女存者，有中道脫者，有全家被虜而親屬偶歸者，一概籍沒，人情皇皇。

translations.literal: (Earlier, officials had said: "A recent edict directed prefectures and counties to register tax obligations of people captured by the enemy, but harsh clerks did not verify the facts. Among them were cases where parents were captured but children remained, cases where people escaped midway, and cases where the whole family was captured but a relative later returned — yet all were registered and confiscated alike, and popular sentiment was in turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: (Earlier officials had said: "A recent edict made prefectures and counties register taxes of people captured by the enemy, but harsh clerks failed to verify facts. Some had parents captured while children remained; some escaped en route; some had whole families captured while a relative later returned — yet all were registered and confiscated alike, stirring public alarm.

sentences.zh: ”故有是命。）〉

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Therefore this order was issued.) — closing section marker.〉
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark. Hence this order.) — end of section note.〉

sentences.zh: 十月，募佃江東、西閑田，三等定租：上田畝輸米一斗五升，中田一斗，下田七升。

translations.literal: In the tenth month tenant farmers were recruited for idle fields in eastern and western Jiang, with rent fixed in three grades: top fields one dou five sheng of rice per mu, middle fields one dou, lower fields seven sheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the court recruited tenants for idle Jiang fields, with three rent grades: top fields one dou five sheng per mu, middle one dou, lower seven sheng.

sentences.zh: 四年，貸廬州民錢萬緡，以買耕牛。

translations.literal: In the fourth year ten thousand strings of cash were lent to the people of Luzhou to buy plow oxen.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 the court lent Luzhou ten thousand strings of cash to buy plow oxen.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，立《守令墾田殿最格》，

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year the 《Standings for Ranking Prefects and Magistrates by Reclaimed Farmland》 was established,
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 5 the court established the 《Standings for Ranking Prefects and Magistrates by Reclaimed Farmland》,

sentences.zh: （殘破州縣墾田增及一分，郡守升三季名次，增及九分，遷一官；

translations.literal: (In devastated prefectures and counties, if reclaimed farmland increased by one-tenth, the prefect advanced three places in the quarterly ranking; if it increased by nine-tenths, he was transferred one rank;
translations.idiomatic: (In devastated prefectures and counties, a one-tenth increase in reclaimed land advanced the prefect three places in quarterly ranking; a nine-tenth increase earned a one-rank promotion;

sentences.zh: 虧及一分，降三季名次，虧及九分，鐫一官。

translations.literal: if it fell short by one-tenth, he dropped three places; if by nine-tenths, one rank was cut.
translations.idiomatic: a one-tenth shortfall dropped him three places; a nine-tenth shortfall cost one rank.

sentences.zh: 縣令差減之。

translations.literal: Magistrates were judged on a reduced scale.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates were judged on a reduced scale.

sentences.zh: 增虧各及十分者，取旨賞罰。

translations.literal: Where increase or shortfall reached the full ten-tenths, imperial discretion determined reward or punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Full ten-tenth increase or shortfall went to the throne for reward or punishment.

sentences.zh: 其後以兩淮、荊湖等路民稍復業，而曠土尚多，戶部復立格上之：每州增墾田千頃，縣半之，守宰各進一秩；

translations.literal: Later, as people on the Two Huai, Jinghu, and other circuits gradually returned to farming while much land still lay vacant, the Ministry of Revenue submitted revised standards: for each prefecture an increase of one thousand qing of reclaimed land, half that for a county, and the prefect and magistrate each advanced one rank;
translations.idiomatic: Later, as people on the Two Huai and Jinghu circuits gradually returned while land still lay idle, the ministry proposed: each prefecture gaining one thousand qing of reclaimed land, half that for counties, with prefect and magistrate each promoted one rank;

sentences.zh: 州虧五百頃，縣虧五之一，皆展磨勘年。

translations.literal: if a prefecture fell short by five hundred qing and a county by one-fifth of that, the term for merit review was extended.
translations.idiomatic: a prefecture short five hundred qing or a county one-fifth of that had merit review extended.

sentences.zh: 詔頒之諸路。

translations.literal: An edict promulgated this to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promulgated this on all circuits.

sentences.zh: 增，謂荒田開墾者；

translations.literal: "Increase" meant wasteland newly opened;
translations.idiomatic: "Increase" meant wasteland newly opened;

sentences.zh: 虧，謂熟田不因災傷而致荒者。）〉

translations.literal: "shortfall" meant fertile fields that became waste without disaster or injury.) — closing section marker.〉
translations.idiomatic: "shortfall" meant fertile fields abandoned without disaster or injury.) — end of section note.〉

sentences.zh: 又令縣具歸業民數及墾田多寡，月上之州，州季上轉運，轉運歲上戶部，戶部置籍以考之。

translations.literal: Counties were also ordered to report monthly the number of returnees and how much land was reclaimed to the prefecture; the prefecture reported quarterly to the transport commissioner; the commissioner reported yearly to the Ministry of Revenue, which kept registers for assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Counties were to report monthly returnee numbers and reclaimed acreage to prefectures; prefectures quarterly to transport commissioners; commissioners yearly to the ministry, which kept assessment registers.

sentences.zh: 七月，都督行府言：“潭、鼎、嶽、澧、荊南歸業之民，其田已佃者，以附近閑田與之，免三年租稅；

translations.literal: In the seventh month the supreme commandery staff said: "For people returning to their occupations in Tan, Ding, Yue, Li, and Jingnan, where their fields are already tenanted, nearby idle fields should be given them, with rent and tax waived for three years;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the supreme commandery said: "Returnees in Tan, Ding, Yue, Li, and Jingnan whose former fields are tenanted should receive nearby idle land with three years' rent and tax waived;

sentences.zh: 無產願受閑田者，亦與之。

translations.literal: those without holdings who wish to take idle fields should also receive them.
translations.idiomatic: those without holdings who want idle fields should also receive them.

sentences.zh: ”上諭輔臣曰：“淮北之民繈負而至，亦可給田，以廣招徠之意。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The emperor told his chief ministers: "People from north of the Huai are arriving with infants on their backs; they too may be given fields, to broaden the policy of recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his ministers: "Refugees from north of the Huai are arriving with infants on their backs; they too should receive fields, to broaden recruitment.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 六年，減江東諸路逃田稅額。

translations.literal: In the sixth year tax quotas on abandoned fields in the Jiangdong circuits were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 tax quotas on abandoned fields in Jiangdong circuits were reduced.

sentences.zh: 知平江府章誼言：“民所甚苦者，催科無法，稅役不均。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi, prefect of Pingjiang, said: "What most afflicts the people is lawless collection and uneven tax and corvee burdens.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang prefect Zhang Yi said: "What most afflicts the people is lawless collection and uneven tax and corvee.

sentences.zh: 強宗巨室阡陌相望，而多無稅之田，使下戶為之破產。

translations.literal: Powerful clans and great houses own fields stretching as far as one can see, yet many pay no tax, forcing humble households to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful clans own vast fields yet pay little tax, driving humble households to ruin.

sentences.zh: 乞委通判一員均平賦役。

translations.literal: I ask that one vice-prefect be delegated to equalize levies and corvee.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that one vice-prefect be assigned to equalize levies and corvee.

sentences.zh: ”九年，宗正少卿方庭實言：“中原士民奔逃南州，十有四年，出違十年之限及流徙僻遠卒未能歸者，望詔有司別立限年。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Fang Tingshi, vice director of the Imperial Clan Court, said: "Gentry and commoners of the central plains have fled south for fourteen years; some exceed the ten-year limit or are too remote to return soon. I hope the relevant offices may set a separate time limit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Imperial Clan vice director Fang Tingshi said: "Central Plains refugees have been in the south fourteen years; some exceed the ten-year limit or are too remote to return. I hope offices will set a separate limit.

sentences.zh: ”戶部議：“自復降赦日為始，再期五年，如期滿無理認者，見佃人依舊承佃。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue deliberated: "Counting from the day of the latest amnesty, after another five-year period, if the deadline passes with no claim, the current tenant may continue under the old lease.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry proposed: "From the latest amnesty, after five more years, if no claim is made, the current tenant may continue.

sentences.zh: 中原士民流寓東南，往往有墳墓，或官拘籍，或民冒占，便行給還。

translations.literal: Central Plains gentry and commoners in the southeast often have graves that are either registered by officials or seized by others; these should be returned at once.
translations.idiomatic: Central Plains refugees in the southeast often have graves registered by officials or seized by others; these should be returned immediately.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，復買牛貸淮南農戶。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year oxen were again purchased and lent to farming households in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 oxen were again bought and lent to Huainan farmers.

sentences.zh: 十二年，左司員外郎李椿年言經界不正十害，且言：“平江歲入昔七十萬有奇，今按籍雖三十九萬斛，然實入才二十萬耳。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Li Chunnian, left office vice director, listed ten harms of incorrect land boundaries and said: "Pingjiang's annual intake was once more than seven hundred thousand, but though the register now shows three hundred ninety thousand hu, actual collection is only two hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 left office vice director Li Chunnian listed ten harms of incorrect boundaries and said: "Pingjiang once took in over 700,000, but though the register shows 390,000 hu, actual collection is only 200,000.

sentences.zh: 詢之土人，皆欺隱也。

translations.literal: Inquiring of locals, all is concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Locals say it is all concealment.

sentences.zh: 望考按核實，自平江始，然後施之天下，則經界正而仁政行矣。

translations.literal: I hope for investigation and verification, beginning in Pingjiang and then extending to the realm, so that boundaries are correct and humane government may be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: I hope for verification beginning in Pingjiang and then the realm, so boundaries are correct and humane government can proceed.

sentences.zh: ”上謂宰執曰：“椿年之論，頗有條理。

translations.literal: The emperor told his chief ministers: "Chunnian's argument is quite orderly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his ministers: "Chunnian's argument is quite orderly.

sentences.zh: ”秦檜亦言其說簡易可行。

translations.literal: Qin Hui also said his plan was simple and feasible.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui also said the plan was simple and feasible.

sentences.zh: 程克俊曰：“比年百姓避役，正緣經界不正。

translations.literal: Cheng Kejun said: "In recent years people have fled corvee precisely because boundaries are incorrect.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Kejun said: "People flee corvee because boundaries are wrong.

sentences.zh: 行之，乃公私之利。

translations.literal: Carrying this out will benefit both public and private interests.
translations.idiomatic: Doing this will benefit both state and people.

sentences.zh: ”以椿年為兩浙路轉運副使，措置經界。

translations.literal: Chunnian was made transport vice commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits to arrange land boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Chunnian was made Two Zhe transport vice commissioner to arrange boundaries.

sentences.zh: 椿年請先往平江諸縣，俟就緒即往諸州，要在均平，為民除害，不增稅額。

translations.literal: Chunnian asked to go first to the counties of Pingjiang and, once finished, proceed to other prefectures, aiming at fairness, removing harm to the people, and not increasing tax quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Chunnian asked to begin in Pingjiang counties, then other prefectures, seeking fairness, removing harm, and not raising quotas.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以提舉洪州玉隆觀胡思、直顯謨閣徐林議沮經界，停官遠徙。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Hu Si, promoter of the Yulong Abbey in Hongzhou, and Xu Lin, gentleman of the Bureau for Eminent Merit, who had obstructed boundary work, were stripped of office and exiled far away.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 Hu Si, promoter of Hongzhou's Yulong Abbey, and Xu Lin, who obstructed boundary work, were demoted and exiled.

sentences.zh: 以民田不上稅簿者沒官，稅簿不謹書者罪官吏。

translations.literal: Private fields not entered on tax registers were confiscated; officials whose tax registers were carelessly kept were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Private fields not on tax registers were confiscated; officials with careless registers were punished.

sentences.zh: 時量田不實者，罪至徒、流，江山尉汪大猷白椿年曰：“法峻，民未喻，固有田少而供多者，願許陳首追正。

translations.literal: At the time those whose measured fields were inaccurate could be punished up to penal servitude or exile. Wang Dayou, assistant magistrate of Jiangshan, told Chunnian: "The law is severe and the people do not yet understand; some have little land but heavy obligations. I hope self-reporting may be allowed to correct this.
translations.idiomatic: Those with inaccurate surveys could face penal servitude or exile. Jiangshan assistant magistrate Wang Dayou told Chunnian: "The law is harsh and people do not understand; some have little land but heavy obligations. Allow self-reporting to correct this.

sentences.zh: ”椿年為之輕刑、省費甚眾。

translations.literal: Chunnian lightened penalties and cut costs greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Chunnian lightened penalties and cut costs greatly.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以椿年權戶部侍郎，措置經界。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Chunnian was made acting vice minister of revenue to arrange boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Chunnian was made acting revenue vice minister for boundary work.

sentences.zh: 尋以母憂去，以兩浙轉運副使王鈇權戶部侍郎措置。

translations.literal: Soon he left on mourning for his mother, and Wang Yue, transport vice commissioner of the Two Zhe circuits, was made acting vice minister of revenue in his place.
translations.idiomatic: He soon left for mourning; Two Zhe transport vice commissioner Wang Yue replaced him as acting revenue vice minister.

sentences.zh: 十五年，詔戶部及所遣官委曲措置，務使賦稅均而無擾。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue and its dispatched officials to arrange matters carefully, so that levies were equal and the people undisturbed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 an edict ordered the ministry and its agents to arrange matters carefully so levies were equal and people undisturbed.

sentences.zh: 又因興國軍守臣宋時言，詔諸州縣違期歸業者，其田已佃及官賣者，即以官田之可耕者給還。

translations.literal: Because Song Shi, an official of Xingguo Army, spoke up, an edict also said that for those returning after the deadline, if their fields were already tenanted or sold by the state, cultivable official fields should be given instead.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xingguo Army official Song Shi spoke up, an edict said late returnees whose fields were tenanted or sold by the state should receive cultivable official fields.

sentences.zh: 十六年，王鈇以疾罷。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Wang Yue resigned because of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 Wang Yue resigned for illness.

sentences.zh: 十七年，復以李椿年權戶部侍郎，措置經界。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Li Chunnian was again made acting vice minister of revenue to arrange boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 Li Chunnian again became acting revenue vice minister for boundary work.

sentences.zh: 先是，真州兵燼之餘，瘡痍未復，洪興祖為守，請復租二年，明年又復請之，自是流民浸歸。

translations.literal: Earlier, after the fires of war at Zhenzhou scars had not healed; Hong Xingzu as prefect asked to remit rent for two years, and the next year asked again; from this refugees gradually returned.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, after Zhenzhou's war damage, prefect Hong Xingzu twice asked two-year rent remissions; refugees gradually returned.

sentences.zh: 十八年，墾荒田至七萬餘畝。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year wasteland reclaimed reached more than seventy thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 wasteland reclaimed exceeded seventy thousand mu.

sentences.zh: 十九年，詔敕令所刪定官鄭克行四川經界法。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year an edict ordered Zheng Ke of the Statutes Revision Office to carry out the Sichuan boundary law.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 an edict ordered Statutes Revision Office official Zheng Ke to carry out the Sichuan boundary law.

sentences.zh: 克頗峻責州縣，所謂“省莊田”者，雖蔬果、桑柘莫不有征，而邛、蜀民田至什稅其伍。

translations.literal: Ke was quite harsh toward prefectures and counties; even vegetables, mulberry, and catalpa on so-called "provincial estate fields" were taxed, and common fields in Qiong and Shu were taxed up to half.
translations.idiomatic: Ke was harsh toward prefectures and counties; even vegetables and mulberry on "provincial estate fields" were taxed, and Qiong-Shu common fields were taxed up to half.

sentences.zh: 通判嘉州楊承曰：“仁政而虐行之，非法意也。

translations.literal: Jiazhou vice prefect Yang Cheng said: "Benevolent government carried out as cruelty is not the intent of law.
translations.idiomatic: Jiazhou vice prefect Yang Cheng said: "Benevolent policy enforced as cruelty violates the law's intent.

sentences.zh: 上不違令，下不擾民，則仁政得矣。

translations.literal: Not violating orders above and not disturbing the people below — then benevolent government is achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Obey orders above without disturbing people below — then benevolent government is achieved.

sentences.zh: ”召諸邑令謂曰：“平易近民，美成在久，其謹行之。

translations.literal: He summoned the county magistrates and said: "Be accessible to the people; lasting success takes time — carry this out carefully.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned magistrates and said: "Be accessible to the people; lasting success takes time — act carefully.

sentences.zh: 無愧於心，何畏焉？

translations.literal: If your conscience is clear, what is there to fear?
translations.idiomatic: If your conscience is clear, what is there to fear?

sentences.zh: ”事迄成，為列郡最。

translations.literal: When the work was finished, his prefecture ranked first among all.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, his prefecture ranked first.

sentences.zh: 其後，民有訴不均者，殿中侍御史曹筠劾椿年，罷之。

translations.literal: Later, when people complained of inequality, palace censor Cao Jun impeached Chunnian and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when people complained of inequality, palace censor Cao Jun impeached Chunnian and he was removed.

sentences.zh: 上謂秦檜曰：“若下田受重稅，將無以輸。

translations.literal: The emperor told Qin Hui: "If lower fields bear heavy tax, they will have nothing to pay.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Qin Hui: "If poor fields bear heavy tax, people cannot pay.

sentences.zh: ”檜曰：“臣已諭戶部侍郎宋貺，有未均處亟與改正。

translations.literal: Qin Hui said: "I have already instructed Vice Minister Song Bian to correct any remaining inequalities at once.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui said: "I have told Vice Minister Song Bian to correct inequalities at once.

sentences.zh: ”二十年，詔：兩淮沃壤宜穀，置力田科，募民就耕，以廣官莊。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year an edict said: fertile soil on the Two Huai is fit for grain; a "strong farming" category was established to recruit people to cultivate and expand official estates.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 an edict said Two Huai fertile land suits grain; a strong-farming category was created to recruit cultivators and expand official estates.

sentences.zh: 知資州楊師錫言：有司奉行失當，田畝不分腴瘠，市居丈尺隙田，亦充稅產。

translations.literal: Yang Shixi, prefect of Zizhou, said the offices carried this out improperly, not distinguishing fertile from poor land and taxing even market gaps measured in inches.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhou prefect Yang Shixi said offices enforced this wrongly, not distinguishing fertile from poor and taxing market gaps measured in inches.

sentences.zh: 於是降詔曰：“椿年乞行經界，去民十害，今聞浸失本意。

translations.literal: Thereupon a lowered edict said: "Chunnian asked to carry out boundaries and remove ten popular harms; now I hear the original intent is gradually lost.
translations.idiomatic: A lowered edict said: "Chunnian sought boundaries to remove ten harms; now the original intent is being lost.

sentences.zh: 凡便民者依已行，害民者與追正。

translations.literal: Whatever benefits the people should follow what has been done; whatever harms them should be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: What benefits the people should stand; what harms them should be corrected.

sentences.zh: ”二十一年四月，宋貺罷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-first year Song Bian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 21 Song Bian was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 二十六年正月，上謂輔臣曰：“經界事李椿年主之，若推行就緒，不為不善。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-sixth year the emperor told his ministers: "Li Chunnian directed the boundary work; if it were carried through properly, it would not be bad.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 26 the emperor told ministers: "Li Chunnian directed boundaries; done properly it would not be bad.

sentences.zh: 今諸路往往中輟，願得一通曉經界者款曲議之。

translations.literal: Now circuits often break off midway; I wish for someone thoroughly versed in boundaries to discuss it carefully.
translations.idiomatic: Now circuits often stop midway; I want someone versed in boundaries to discuss it carefully.

sentences.zh: ”會潼川府轉運判官王之望上書，言蜀中經界利害甚悉。

translations.literal: At the same time Wang Zhiwang, transport vice judge of Tongchuan prefecture, submitted a memorial detailing the pros and cons of boundaries in Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Tongchuan transport vice judge Wang Zhiwang submitted a detailed memorial on Shu boundaries.

sentences.zh: 明年，以之望提點刑獄，畢經界事。

translations.literal: The next year he was made judicial intendant and completed the boundary work.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was made judicial intendant and finished boundary work.

sentences.zh: 三月，戶部言：“蜀地狹人夥，而京西、淮南膏腴官田尚多，許人承佃，官貸牛、種，八年仍償。

translations.literal: In the third month the Ministry of Revenue said: "Shu is narrow and populous, while in the western capital circuit and Huainan much fertile official land still lies idle; people may be allowed to lease it, with official loans of oxen and seed, repaid after eight years.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the ministry said: "Shu is crowded while western capital and Huainan still have idle fertile official land; people may lease it with official oxen and seed loans, repaid in eight years.

sentences.zh: 並邊免租十年，次邊半之，滿三年與其業。

translations.literal: Border districts would be rent-free for ten years, next-tier border districts half that, and after three years the holding would be theirs.
translations.idiomatic: Border districts would be rent-free ten years, next-tier border half that, and after three years the holding would be theirs.

sentences.zh: 願往者給據津發。

translations.literal: Those willing to go would be given transit documents and sent on.
translations.idiomatic: Willing migrants would receive transit documents.

sentences.zh: ”上曰：“善。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Good.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Good."

sentences.zh: 但貧民乍請荒田，安能便得牛、種？

translations.literal: But poor people suddenly applying for wasteland — how can they at once obtain oxen and seed?
translations.idiomatic: But poor people applying for wasteland cannot at once get oxen and seed.

sentences.zh: 若不從官貸，未免為虛文，可令相度支給。

translations.literal: If official loans are not given, it will remain empty words; they may be directed to supply them as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Without official loans it is empty policy; direct appropriate supply.

sentences.zh: ”四月，通判安豐軍王時升言：“淮南土皆膏腴，然地未盡辟、民不加多者，緣豪強虛占良田，而無遍耕之力；

translations.literal: In the fourth month Wang Shisheng, vice prefect of Anfeng Army, said: "Huainan soil is all fertile, yet land is not fully opened and population does not grow because powerful households falsely occupy good fields without the strength to farm them all;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Anfeng vice prefect Wang Shisheng said: "Huainan soil is fertile, yet land stays unopened because powerful households falsely occupy good fields without strength to farm them all;

sentences.zh: 流民繈負而至，而無開耕之地。

translations.literal: refugees arrive carrying infants on their backs yet find no land to open.
translations.idiomatic: refugees arrive with infants yet find no land to open.

sentences.zh: 望凡荒閑田許人剗佃。

translations.literal: I hope all wasteland and idle fields may be allowed to anyone who clears and cultivates them.
translations.idiomatic: I hope all wasteland may be cleared by whoever will cultivate it.

sentences.zh: ”戶部議：期以二年，未墾者即如所請；

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue deliberated: a two-year deadline was set; if not reclaimed, the request would stand as proposed;
translations.idiomatic: The ministry set a two-year deadline; unreclaimed land would follow the proposal;

sentences.zh: 京西路如之。

translations.literal: the western capital circuit would follow the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: the western capital circuit would follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 詔以時升為司農寺丞。

translations.literal: An edict made Shisheng a director in the Ministry of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Shisheng a director in the Ministry of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 十月，用御史中丞湯鵬舉言，離軍添差之人，授以江、淮、湖南荒田，人一頃，為世業。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, following a memorial by Censor-in-Chief Tang Pengju, persons detached from the army with extra assignments were granted one qing of wasteland each in the Yangtze-Huai and Hunan regions as hereditary holdings.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, following Censor-in-Chief Tang Pengju, persons detached from the army were granted one qing each of Yangtze-Huai and Hunan wasteland as hereditary holdings.

sentences.zh: 所在郡以一歲奉充牛、種費，仍免租稅十年，丁役二十年。

translations.literal: The prefecture where they resided would use one year's revenue to cover oxen and seed expenses, while still exempting rent and tax for ten years and corvee labor for twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: The host prefecture would devote one year's tax receipts to oxen and seed, while still granting ten years' exemption from rent and tax and twenty years' exemption from corvee.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，王之望言：“去年分遣官詣經界不均縣裁正，今已迄事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Wang Zhiwang said: "Last year officials were dispatched to counties where field boundaries were unequal to rectify them; the matter is now concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Wang Zhiwang reported: "Last year the court sent officials to counties with unequal field boundaries to correct them, and that work is now finished.

sentences.zh: 此後吏民尚敢扇搖以疑百姓者，乞重置於法。

translations.literal: If hereafter officials or commoners still dare to stir up doubt among the people, I beg they be severely dealt with under the law.
translations.idiomatic: If officials or locals still stir up doubts among the people hereafter, I ask that they be punished to the full extent of the law.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，知潭州魏良臣言：“本州歸業之民，以熟田為荒，不輸租。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Wei Liangchen, prefect of Tanzhou, said: "In this prefecture people returning to their occupations report fertile fields as wasteland and pay no rent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Tanzhou prefect Wei Liangchen said: "Returnees in this prefecture are reporting fertile fields as wasteland and paying no rent.

sentences.zh: 今令給甲輸稅，自明年始，不實，許人告，以為田賞之。

translations.literal: Now order household registers issued for tax payment starting next year; if untrue, allow people to report it and take the land as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Issue household registers for tax payment beginning next year; if the report is false, allow informers to claim the land as reward.

sentences.zh: ”戶部議：“期逾百日，依匿稅法。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The Ministry of Revenue deliberated: "If the deadline exceeds one hundred days, apply the concealed-tax law.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue ruled: "If the deadline exceeds one hundred days, apply the law on concealed taxes.

sentences.zh: ”詔可。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 三十年，初令純州平江縣民實田輸稅，畝輸米二升四合。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, for the first time the people of Pingjiang County in Chunzhou were ordered to pay tax on actual fields, two sheng four ge of rice per mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year the court first required the people of Pingjiang County, Chunzhou, to pay tax on actual acreage, at two sheng four ge of rice per mu.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，詔曰：“朕深惟治不加進，思有以正其本者。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year an edict said: "I deeply reflect that governance does not advance and seek means to rectify its root.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year an edict declared: "I have deeply considered why rule does not improve and seek a way to set its foundations right.

sentences.zh: 今欲均役法，嚴限田，抑遊手，務農桑。

translations.literal: Now I wish to equalize the corvee law, strictly limit fields, suppress idlers, and devote effort to farming and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: I now intend to equalize corvee obligations, enforce field limits, restrain idlers, and promote farming and sericulture.

sentences.zh: 凡是數者，卿等二三大臣為朕任之。

translations.literal: For all these matters, you two or three great ministers shall undertake them for me.
translations.idiomatic: For each of these tasks, let you two or three senior ministers take charge on my behalf.

sentences.zh: ”十有二月，監進奏院李結獻《治田三議》：一曰務本，二曰協力，三曰因時。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. In the twelfth month Li Jie of the Memorial Reception Bureau presented the 《Three Proposals on Governing Fields》: first, attend to fundamentals; second, cooperate in strength; third, accord with the season.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Jie of the Memorial Reception Bureau submitted the 《Three Proposals on Governing Fields》: first, secure the fundamentals; second, pool labor; third, follow the seasons.

sentences.zh: 大略謂：“浙西低田恃堤為固，若堤岸高厚，則水不能入。

translations.literal: In outline he said: "The low fields of western Zhejiang rely on dikes for security; if dike banks are high and thick, water cannot enter.
translations.idiomatic: In summary he argued: "Western Zhejiang's low fields depend on dikes for protection; if the banks are raised high and thick, floodwater cannot enter.

sentences.zh: 乞於蘇、湖、常、秀諸州水田塘浦要處，官以錢米貸田主，乘此農隙，作堰增令高闊，則堤成而水不為患。

translations.literal: I beg that at key places in the paddy fields and ponds of Su, Hu, Chang, and Xiu prefectures the government lend money and grain to landholders; taking advantage of this agricultural slack season, build weirs and raise them high and broad, then the dikes will be complete and water will not be a calamity.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that at critical paddy and pond sites in Su, Hu, Chang, and Xiu the state lend money and grain to landowners, use the farming slack season to build and heighten weirs, and so complete the dikes so water would no longer threaten the fields.

sentences.zh: 方此饑饉，俾食其力，因其所利而利之。

translations.literal: Just now in this famine, let them eat by their labor and profit by what profits them.
translations.idiomatic: In the present famine, let the people live by their labor and turn the work to their own advantage.

sentences.zh: 秋冬旱涸，涇浜斷流，車畎修築，尤為省力。

translations.literal: In autumn and winter during drought, when streams and canals dry up, cart-ditch construction and repair are especially labor-saving.
translations.idiomatic: In the dry autumn and winter season, when canals run low, repairing fields by cart-drawn ditches is especially economical of labor.

sentences.zh: ”詔令胡堅常相度以聞。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict ordered Hu Jianchang to survey the matter and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Hu Jianchang to survey the proposal and report back.

sentences.zh: 其後，戶部以三議切當，但工力浩瀚，欲曉有田之家，各依鄉原畝步出錢米與租田之人，更相修築，庶官無所費，民不告勞。

translations.literal: Afterward the Ministry of Revenue found the three proposals apt, but the labor was vast; they wished to inform households with land to contribute money and grain by local mu pace to those who rented their fields and mutually repair the works, so the government would spend nothing and the people would not complain of toil.
