translations.idiomatic: Later the Ministry of Revenue judged the three proposals sound but the labor enormous, and proposed notifying landowners to contribute money and grain by local acre measure to their tenants for joint repairs, so the state would bear no cost and the people would not be overburdened.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，知揚州晁公武奏：“朝廷以沿淮荒殘之久，未行租稅，民復業與創戶者，雖阡陌相望，然聞之官者十才二三，咸懼後來稅重。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year Yangzhou prefect Chao Gongwu memorialized: "The court, because the Huai frontier has long been devastated, has not imposed rent and tax; people returning to occupation and new households, though fields stretch in sight of one another, yet those reported to officials are only two or three in ten, all fearing heavy taxes later.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year Yangzhou prefect Chao Gongwu submitted: "Because the Huai borderlands have long lain waste, the court has not yet levied rent and tax. Returnees and new households may fill the fields as far as one can see, yet only two or three in ten are reported to officials, for all fear heavier taxes to come.

sentences.zh: 昔晚唐民務稼穡則增其租，故播種少；

translations.literal: In former times in late Tang, when the people devoted themselves to farming, rent was increased, so sowing was little;
translations.idiomatic: In late Tang, when the people turned to farming, rents were raised, and sowing declined;

sentences.zh: 吳越民墾荒田而不加稅，故無曠土。

translations.literal: In Wu and Yue the people reclaimed wasteland without added tax, so there was no idle land.
translations.idiomatic: In Wu and Yue the people opened wasteland without added tax, and no land lay idle.

sentences.zh: 望詔兩淮更不增賦，庶民知勸。

translations.literal: I hope an edict that the two Huai circuits will not increase levies, so the people may know encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that an edict declare the Two Huai circuits will levy no further increases, so the people may be encouraged to cultivate.

sentences.zh: ”詔可。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 十月，司馬伋請勸民種麥，為來春之計。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Sima Ji requested urging the people to plant wheat as a plan for the coming spring.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Sima Ji asked the court to urge wheat planting as preparation for the coming spring.

sentences.zh: 於是詔江東西、湖南北、淮東西路帥漕，官為借種及諭大姓假貸農民廣種，依賑濟格推賞，仍上已種頃畝，議賞罰。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict went to the Jiangdong and Jiangxi, Hunan and Hubei, and Huaidong and Huaixi circuit commanders and transport commissioners: the government would lend seed and instruct great clans to lend to farmers for broad planting; rewards would follow relief standards; they were still to report planted qing and mu for deliberation on rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered the Jiangdong, Jiangxi, Hunan, Hubei, Huaidong, and Huaixi commanders and transport officials to lend seed on the state's behalf and urge great families to lend to farmers for wider planting, grant rewards under relief regulations, and report planted acreage for reward and punishment.

sentences.zh: 九年，王之奇奏增定力田賞格，募人開耕荒田，給官告綾紙以備書填，及官會十萬緡充農具等用。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Wang Zhiqi memorialized to increase the fixed rewards for diligent farming, recruit people to open and cultivate wasteland, supply official appointment documents and silk paper for filling in, and one hundred thousand strings from the official treasury for farm tools and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Wang Zhiqi proposed raising the fixed rewards for steadfast farming, recruiting cultivators for wasteland, providing official appointment documents and silk paper for records, and allocating one hundred thousand strings from the treasury for farm tools and related expenses.

sentences.zh: 以種糧不足，又詔淮東總領所借給稻三萬石。

translations.literal: Because seed grain was insufficient, another edict had the Huaidong regional headquarters lend thirty thousand shi of rice.
translations.idiomatic: When seed grain proved insufficient, the court further ordered the Huaidong regional headquarters to lend thirty thousand shi of rice.

sentences.zh: 淳熙五年，詔：“湖北佃戶開墾荒田，止輸舊稅。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chunxi an edict said: "Hubei tenant households who open and reclaim wasteland pay only the old tax.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chunxi an edict declared: "Hubei tenants who reclaim wasteland shall pay only the former tax rate.

sentences.zh: 若包占頃畝，未悉開耕，詔下之日，期以二年，不能遍耕者拘作營田，其增稅、剗佃之令勿行。

translations.literal: If they occupy qing and mu but do not fully cultivate them, from the date of the edict a two-year deadline is set; those who cannot farm all the land are seized as government fields; orders for increased tax and eviction do not apply.
translations.idiomatic: Those who claim acreage but do not fully cultivate it are given two years from the edict's promulgation; land not fully worked is taken as state fields, and orders for higher tax or eviction shall not apply.

sentences.zh: ”六年五月，提舉浙西常平茶鹽顏師魯奏：“設勸課之法，欲重農桑、廣種植也。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. In the fifth month of the sixth year Yan Shilu, intendant of western Zhejiang Ever-Normal tea and salt, memorialized: "Establishing encouragement laws aims to stress farming and sericulture and broaden planting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year Yan Shilu, western Zhejiang intendant for Ever-Normal tea and salt, wrote: "The encouragement laws were meant to promote farming, sericulture, and wider planting.

sentences.zh: 今鄉民於己田連接閑曠磽確之地，墾成田園，用力甚勤。

translations.literal: Now villagers on idle, stony land adjoining their own fields have reclaimed gardens with great labor.
translations.idiomatic: Villagers are now diligently reclaiming adjoining idle and stony ground into fields and gardens.

sentences.zh: 或以未陳起稅，為人所訟，即以盜耕罪之，何以勸力田哉？

translations.literal: Some, because they did not report for tax assessment, are sued by others and convicted of illicit cultivation--how does this encourage diligent farming?
translations.idiomatic: Yet some are denounced and punished for illicit cultivation because they failed to register the new land for tax--how can this encourage diligent farming?

sentences.zh: 止宜實田起稅，非特可戢告訐之風，亦見盛世重農之意。

translations.literal: One should only assess tax on actual fields; this not only checks the wind of informers but also shows the flourishing age's intent to value agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Tax should be levied only on actual acreage; this would curb malicious suits and show that the age truly values agriculture.

sentences.zh: ”詔可。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，臣僚奏：“比令諸路帥、漕督守令勸諭種麥，歲上所增頃畝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month officials memorialized: "Recently the court ordered circuit commanders and transport commissioners to supervise prefects and magistrates in urging wheat planting and annually report increased qing and mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month officials reported: "The court recently ordered circuit commanders and transport commissioners to supervise local officials in urging wheat planting and to report annual increases in acreage.

sentences.zh: 然土有宜否，湖南一路唯衡、永等數郡宜麥，餘皆文具。

translations.literal: Yet soil suits or does not; in the Hunan circuit only Heng, Yong, and several other prefectures suit wheat; the rest are mere paperwork.
translations.idiomatic: Yet soil varies in suitability: in Hunan only Heng, Yong, and a few other prefectures are fit for wheat, while the rest produce only paper reports.

sentences.zh: 望止諭民以時播種，免其歲上增種之數，庶得勸課之實。

translations.literal: I hope only to instruct the people to sow in season and exempt the annual figure for increased planting, so encouragement may gain reality.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the court simply urge timely sowing and waive the annual quota for added planting, so the encouragement policy may have real effect.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 七年，復詔兩浙、江、淮、湖南、京西路帥、漕臣督守令勸民種麥，務要增廣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year an edict again ordered the commanders and transport commissioners of the Liang-Zhe, Jiang, Huai, Hunan, and Jingxi circuits to supervise prefects and magistrates in urging the people to plant wheat, striving for expansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the court again ordered the Liang-Zhe, Jiang, Huai, Hunan, and Jingxi commanders and transport officials to supervise local authorities in urging wheat planting and to seek real expansion.

sentences.zh: 自是每歲如之。

translations.literal: From then on it was so every year.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the order was repeated every year.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，詔曰：“乃者得天之時，蠶麥既登，及命近甸取而視之，則穗短繭薄，非種植風厲之功有所未至歟？

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year an edict said: "Recently, having heaven's season, silkworms and wheat were both harvested; yet when the near suburbs were ordered to be examined, the ears were short and the cocoons thin--has the merit of planting and custom encouragement not fully reached?
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year an edict declared: "Heaven has lately favored the season and both silkworms and wheat have been harvested, yet when the nearby countryside was inspected the grain ears were short and the cocoons thin--has encouragement of planting and local custom not yet done its work?

sentences.zh: 朕將稽勤惰而詔賞罰焉。

translations.literal: I will examine diligence and sloth and proclaim rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: I shall review diligence and neglect and issue rewards and punishments accordingly.

sentences.zh: ”是歲連雨，下田被浸，詔兩浙諸州軍與常平司措置，再借種糧與下戶播種，毋致失時。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. That year continuous rain flooded the low fields; an edict ordered the prefectures and army districts of the two Zhejiangs and the Ever-Normal offices to arrange matters and again lend seed grain to lower households for planting, so the season would not be missed.
translations.idiomatic: That year unbroken rain inundated the low fields, and the court ordered the Zhejiang prefectures and Ever-Normal offices to lend seed again to poorer households for planting so the season would not be lost.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，輔臣奏：“田世雄言，民有麥田，雖墾無種，若貸與貧民，猶可種春麥。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month assisting ministers memorialized: "Tian Shixiong said that people have wheat fields already tilled but without seed; if lent to the poor, spring wheat can still be planted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the chief ministers reported: "Tian Shixiong said that many households have plowed wheat fields but no seed; if seed were lent to the poor, spring wheat could still be sown.

sentences.zh: 臣僚亦言，江、浙旱田雖已耕，亦無麥種。

translations.literal: Officials also said that in Jiang and Zhe the dry fields, though already plowed, likewise lack wheat seed.
translations.idiomatic: Other officials added that in Jiang and Zhe the dry fields, though plowed, also lack wheat seed.

sentences.zh: ”於是詔諸路帥、漕、常平司，以常平麥貸之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon an edict ordered the circuit commanders, transport commissioners, and Ever-Normal offices of all circuits to lend Ever-Normal wheat.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered all circuit commanders, transport officials, and Ever-Normal offices to lend wheat from the Ever-Normal stores.

sentences.zh: 先是，知揚州鄭良嗣言：“兩淮民田，廣至包占，多未起稅。

translations.literal: Earlier Yangzhou prefect Zheng Liangsi said: "In the two Huai circuits people's fields are broadly occupied, and most have not yet been assessed for tax.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yangzhou prefect Zheng Liangsi reported: "Across the Two Huai, people have widely claimed fields, and most remain unassessed for tax.

sentences.zh: 朝廷累限展首，今限滿適旱，乞更展一年。

translations.literal: The court repeatedly extended the deadlines; now the deadline has arrived just as drought came; I beg another year's extension.
translations.idiomatic: The court has repeatedly extended the deadlines, but the term has now expired amid drought; I ask for one more year.

sentences.zh: ”詔如其請。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted the request.

sentences.zh: 九年，著作郎袁樞振兩淮還，奏：“民占田不知其數，二稅既免，止輸穀帛之課。

translations.literal: In the ninth year archival gentleman Yuan Shu returned from inspecting the two Huai circuits and memorialized: "The people occupy fields of unknown number; the two taxes are already exempt, and they pay only grain-and-cloth levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year archival compiler Yuan Shu returned from inspecting the Two Huai and reported: "The people hold land in untold amounts; the two taxes are already waived, and they pay only grain-and-cloth levies.

sentences.zh: 力不能墾，則廢為荒地；

translations.literal: Lacking strength to cultivate, they abandon the land to wasteland;
translations.idiomatic: When they lack strength to farm it, the land is left waste;

sentences.zh: 他人請佃，則以疆界為詞，官無稽考。

translations.literal: when others request to rent it, they raise boundary disputes as pretext, and officials have no means of examination.
translations.idiomatic: when others seek to rent it, boundary disputes are raised as pretexts, and officials have no way to verify the claims.

sentences.zh: 是以野不加辟，戶不加多，而郡縣之計益窘。

translations.literal: Thus the wilderness is not further opened, households do not increase, and prefecture and county accounts grow ever strained.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the wasteland is not opened, households do not grow, and prefectural and county revenues grow ever tighter.

sentences.zh: 望詔州縣畫疆立券，占田多而輸課少者，隨畝增之；

translations.literal: I hope an edict that prefectures and counties demarcate boundaries and issue deeds; for those who occupy much land but pay little tax, increase the levy by mu;
translations.idiomatic: I ask that prefectures and counties demarcate boundaries and issue deeds, and raise taxes by the mu for those who hold much land but pay little;

sentences.zh: 其餘閑田，給與佃人，庶幾流民有可耕之地，而田萊不至多荒。

translations.literal: the remaining idle land be given to tenants, so that perhaps refugees will have land to cultivate and fields will not lie overly waste.
translations.idiomatic: and assign remaining idle land to tenants, so refugees may have fields to work and the countryside may not lie largely fallow.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年，初，朱熹為泉之同安簿，知二郡經界不行之害。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxi, earlier Zhu Xi had been registrar of Tong'an in Quanzhou and knew the harm of field boundaries not being implemented in the two circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxi, Zhu Xi had earlier served as Tong'an registrar in Quan and knew the harm when field boundaries were not enforced in the region.

sentences.zh: 至是，知漳州。

translations.literal: At this time he was prefect of Zhangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: By then he was prefect of Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 會臣僚請行閩中經界，詔監司條具，事下郡。

translations.literal: When officials requested implementing field boundaries in central Fujian, an edict ordered supervisory officials to itemize plans and the matter was sent down to the prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When officials asked to implement field boundaries in Fujian, the court ordered supervisory commissioners to draft plans and referred the matter to the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 熹訪問講求，纖悉備至。

translations.literal: Xi inquired and studied the matter, minute details fully prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi investigated the subject thoroughly, leaving no detail unattended.

sentences.zh: 乃奏言：“經界最為民間莫大之利，紹興已推行處，公私兩利，獨泉，漳、汀未行。

translations.literal: He then memorialized: "Field boundaries are the greatest benefit to the common people; where they were implemented in the Shaoxing era both public and private interests gained, yet only Quan, Zhang, and Ting have not carried them out.
translations.idiomatic: He then submitted: "Field boundaries are the greatest benefit the people can receive. Where they were implemented in the Shaoxing era both state and people profited, yet only Quan, Zhang, and Ting have not done so.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢先一身之勞逸，而後一州之利病，切獨任其必可行也。

translations.literal: Your servant dares not put his own ease or toil first and the prefecture's welfare afterward; I solely undertake that it must be feasible.
translations.idiomatic: I dare not put my own comfort before the prefecture's welfare and personally pledge that the measure can be made to work.

sentences.zh: 然必推擇官吏，委任責成；

translations.literal: Yet officials must be carefully selected and responsibility entrusted to completion;
translations.idiomatic: Yet officials must be carefully chosen and given clear responsibility;

sentences.zh: 度量步畝，算計精確；

translations.literal: paces and mu must be measured and calculations made precise;
translations.idiomatic: fields must be measured in precise paces and mu;

sentences.zh: 畫圖造帳，費從官給；

translations.literal: maps drawn and registers made, expenses supplied by the government;
translations.idiomatic: maps and registers prepared at state expense;

sentences.zh: 隨產均稅，特許過鄉通縣均紐，庶幾百里之內，輕重齊同。

translations.literal: tax by yield with special permission to cross townships and counties for averaging, so that within a hundred li burdens may be alike.
translations.idiomatic: taxes assessed by yield, with special permission to average burdens across townships and counties so that within a hundred li the burdens may be equal.

sentences.zh: 今欲每畝隨九等高下定計產錢，而合一州租稅錢米之數，以產錢為母，每文輸米幾何，錢幾何，止於一倉一庫受納。

translations.literal: Now I wish each mu, according to the nine grades of quality, to set yield money; then combine the prefecture's totals for rent, tax, money, and grain; using yield money as the base, how much rice and how much cash per wen, with receipt only at one granary and one treasury.
translations.idiomatic: I propose setting yield money for each mu by the nine land grades, combining the prefecture's rent and tax totals in money and grain, using yield money as the basis to calculate rice and cash per wen, and collecting payment at a single granary and treasury.

sentences.zh: 既輸之後，卻視原額分隸為省計，為職田，為學糧，為常平，各撥入諸倉庫。

translations.literal: After payment, then according to the original quotas allocate portions to provincial accounts, official fields, school grain, and Ever-Normal stores, each transferred to the various warehouses.
translations.idiomatic: After collection, the amounts would be divided according to the original quotas among provincial revenue, official fields, school grain, and Ever-Normal stores and transferred to the appropriate warehouses.

sentences.zh: 版圖一定，則民業有經矣。

translations.literal: Once the land registers are fixed, the people's estates will have a constant rule.
translations.idiomatic: Once the land registers are fixed, the people's holdings will have a secure foundation.

sentences.zh: 但此法之行，貧民下戶固所深喜，然不能自達其情；

translations.literal: But in implementing this law, poor people and lower households are indeed deeply pleased, yet cannot express their own situation;
translations.idiomatic: Yet in carrying out this law, the poor and lower households would deeply welcome it but cannot make their wishes heard;

sentences.zh: 豪家猾吏實所不樂，皆善為說辭，以惑群聽；

translations.literal: powerful households and crafty clerks are truly displeased and are all skilled at rhetoric to confuse public hearing;
translations.idiomatic: wealthy families and corrupt clerks are truly displeased and are adept at persuasive talk to mislead the crowd;

sentences.zh: 賢士大夫之喜安靜、厭紛擾者，又或不深察而望風沮怯，此則不能無慮。

translations.literal: worthy gentry who love quiet and hate turmoil may also fail to examine deeply and shrink at rumor; on this one cannot be without concern.
translations.idiomatic: and worthy gentlemen who prefer quiet and dislike disturbance may fail to look closely and shrink at rumor--on this I cannot be without concern.

sentences.zh: ”輔臣請行於漳州。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Assisting ministers requested implementation in Zhangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers asked that the measure be carried out in Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 明年春，詔漕臣陳公亮同熹協力奉行。

translations.literal: The next spring an edict ordered transport commissioner Chen Gongliang to join Xi in jointly carrying it out with full effort.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring the court ordered transport commissioner Chen Gongliang to work with Zhu Xi in implementing the plan.

sentences.zh: 會農事方興，熹益加講究，冀來歲行之。

translations.literal: As farming was then in full swing, Xi further studied the matter, hoping to implement it the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: Farming was then at its height, so Zhu Xi studied the plan further, hoping to put it into effect the next year.

sentences.zh: 細民知其不擾而利於己，莫不鼓舞，而貴家豪右占田隱稅、侵漁貧弱者，胥為異論以搖之，前詔遂格。

translations.literal: Common people, knowing it would not harass them and would benefit themselves, all rejoiced; but noble families and powerful elites who occupied land, concealed tax, and oppressed the poor all alike raised divergent arguments to shake the plan, and the earlier edict was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary people, seeing that the reform would not harass them and would serve their interests, were elated; but powerful families that held land, concealed taxes, and preyed on the poor all raised objections to shake the project, and the earlier edict was set aside.

sentences.zh: 熹請祠去。

translations.literal: Xi requested temple leave and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi asked leave to a temple post and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五年，蠲廬州旱傷百姓貸稻種三萬二千一百石。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the court remitted thirty-two thousand one hundred shi of lent rice seed to drought-stricken common people in Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the court remitted thirty-two thousand one hundred shi of rice seed lent to drought victims in Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年二月，上以歲凶，百姓饑病，詔曰：“朕德菲薄，饑饉薦臻，使民阽於死亡，夙夜慘怛，寧敢諉過於下耶？

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Qingyuan, because the year was bad and the people were hungry and sick, an edict said: "My virtue is slight; famines come in succession and drive the people to death's brink; day and night I am distressed--how dare I shift blame to those below?
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Qingyuan, because the harvest failed and the people suffered hunger and sickness, an edict declared: "My virtue is slight; famine follows famine and the people stand at death's door. Day and night I am anguished--how dare I lay the blame on my officials?

sentences.zh: 顧使者、守令所與朕分寄而共憂也，乃涉春以來，聞一二郡老稚乏食，去南畝，捐溝壑，咎安在耶？

translations.literal: Yet envoys, prefects, and magistrates are those with whom I share trust and common worry; yet since spring I have heard that in one or two prefectures the old and young lack food, leave the southern fields, and cast themselves into ditches--where does the fault lie?
translations.idiomatic: Yet the envoys, prefects, and magistrates share my trust and my cares; since spring I have heard that in one or two prefectures the old and young lack food, abandon their fields, and fall into the ditches--where does the fault lie?

sentences.zh: 豈振給不盡及民歟？

translations.literal: Is it that relief does not fully reach the people?
translations.idiomatic: Is relief failing to reach the people?

sentences.zh: 得粟者未必饑，饑者未必得歟？

translations.literal: Those who obtain grain are not necessarily hungry, and the hungry do not necessarily obtain it?
translations.idiomatic: Are those who receive grain not always the hungry, and the hungry not always those who receive it?

sentences.zh: 偏聚於所近，不能均濟歟？

translations.literal: Is it gathered only near at hand and unable to be balanced in relief?
translations.idiomatic: Is grain hoarded nearby and not shared evenly?

sentences.zh: 官吏視成而自不省歟？

translations.literal: Do officials treat the task as complete and fail to examine themselves?
translations.idiomatic: Do officials treat the work as done and fail to examine themselves?

sentences.zh: 其各恪意措畫，務使實惠不壅，毋以虛文蒙上，則朕汝嘉。

translations.literal: Let each diligently plan, striving to ensure real benefit is not blocked and not deceive superiors with empty documents; then I will commend you.
translations.idiomatic: Let each of you plan diligently, see that real benefit is not blocked, and not deceive the throne with empty reports--then I shall commend you.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 寧宗開禧元年，夔路轉運判官範蓀言：“本路施、黔等州荒遠，綿亙山谷，地曠人稀，其占田多者須人耕墾，富豪之家誘客戶舉室遷去。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaixi under Emperor Ningzong, Fan Sun, vice transport commissioner of the Kuizhou circuit, said: "In this circuit Shi, Qian, and other prefectures are remote and waste; mountains stretch continuously; land is vast and people sparse; those who occupy much land need people to cultivate it, and wealthy families entice clients to move their whole households away.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaixi under Emperor Ningzong, Kuizhou vice transport commissioner Fan Sun reported: "In this circuit prefectures such as Shi and Qian lie remote among the mountains, with broad land and few people. Large landowners need cultivators, yet wealthy families entice tenant clients to move away with their entire households.

sentences.zh: 乞將皇祐官莊客戶逃移之法校定：凡為客戶者，許役其身，毋及其家屬；

translations.literal: I beg that the Huangyou law on flight of official-estate clients be revised: for all who are clients, only their persons may be compelled to serve, not their families;
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Huangyou law on flight of official-estate clients be revised: clients may be required to labor in person, but not with their entire families;

sentences.zh: 凡典賣田宅，聽其離業，毋就租以充客戶；

translations.literal: for all who sell fields and houses, let them leave the occupation and not be forced into tenancy as clients;
translations.idiomatic: those who sell fields or houses may leave the land and not be forced into tenancy as clients;

sentences.zh: 凡貸錢，止憑文約交還，毋抑勒以為地客；

translations.literal: for all loans, repayment should rely only on written agreements, without coercion to make land clients;
translations.idiomatic: loans shall be repaid only according to written agreements, without coercion into land tenancy;

sentences.zh: 凡客戶身故、其妻改嫁者，聽其自便，女聽其自嫁。

translations.literal: when a client dies or his wife remarries, let them act as they wish; daughters may marry as they choose.
translations.idiomatic: when a client dies or his wife remarries, they shall be free to do as they wish, and daughters free to marry as they choose.

sentences.zh: 庶使深山窮穀之民，得安生理。

translations.literal: So that the people of deep mountains and remote valleys may secure their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: So that the people of remote mountain valleys may live in security.

sentences.zh: ”刑部以皇祐逃移舊法輕重適中，可以經久，淳熙比附略人之法太重，今後凡理訴官莊客戶，並用皇祐舊法。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The Ministry of Justice held that the old Huangyou law on flight was moderate in severity and could endure; the Chunxi analogy to the law on abducting persons was too heavy; henceforth in all suits concerning official-estate clients the old Huangyou law would be used.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Justice ruled that the old Huangyou law on client flight was balanced and durable, whereas the Chunxi analogy to abduction law was too severe; henceforth all suits involving official-estate clients would follow the Huangyou statute.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 嘉定八年，左司諫黃序奏：“雨澤愆期，地多荒白。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiading Left Secretariat remonstrator Huang Xu memorialized: "Rain has been delayed beyond its season and much land lies white and waste.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiading Left Secretariat remonstrator Huang Xu reported: "Rain has failed to come on time and much land lies fallow.

sentences.zh: 知餘杭縣趙師恕請勸民雜種麻、粟、豆、麥之屬，蓋種稻則費少利多，雜種則勞多獲少。

translations.literal: Yuhang magistrate Zhao Shishu requested urging the people to plant mixed crops such as hemp, millet, beans, and wheat, for planting rice costs little and gains much, while mixed planting costs much labor and gains little.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhang magistrate Zhao Shishu proposed urging the people to plant mixed crops such as hemp, millet, beans, and wheat, noting that rice costs little labor for great return whereas mixed crops cost much labor for little gain.

sentences.zh: 慮收成之日，田主欲分，官課責輸，則非徒無益；

translations.literal: He feared that at harvest the landholders would want a share and official levies would be demanded, and then it would be not only without benefit;
translations.idiomatic: He feared that at harvest landlords would demand a share and officials would levy taxes, so the effort would bring no benefit;

sentences.zh: 若使之從便雜種，多寡皆為己有，則不勸而勤，民可無饑。

translations.literal: if they were allowed freely to plant mixed crops and keep much or little as their own, then without urging they would be diligent and the people could escape hunger.
translations.idiomatic: but if people were allowed to plant mixed crops freely and keep the whole yield, they would work diligently without urging and hunger could be avoided.

sentences.zh: 望如所陳，下兩浙、兩淮、江東西等路，凡有耕種失時者並令雜種，主毋分其地利，官毋取其秋苗，庶幾農民得以續食，官免振救之費。

translations.literal: It is hoped that as stated, orders be sent down to the Two Zhe, Two Huai, Jiangdong and Jiangxi circuits; wherever planting has missed its season, all are to plant mixed crops; masters shall not divide the land's profit, officials shall not take the autumn crop, so that farmers may continue to eat and officials may be spared relief expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that, as proposed, edicts go out to the Two Zhe, Two Huai, and Jiangdong and Jiangxi circuits ordering mixed planting wherever the season had been missed, with landlords barred from taking a share of the yield and officials barred from seizing the autumn crop, so peasants could keep eating and the state could avoid relief costs.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 知婺州趙{與心}夫行經界於其州，整有倫緒，而 {與心}夫報罷。

translations.literal: Wuzhou prefect Zhao Yuxin carried out land-boundary registration in his prefecture with sound order, but Yuxin was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yuxin, prefect of Wuzhou, conducted a well-ordered land-boundary survey in his jurisdiction, but Yuxin was then recalled from office.

sentences.zh: 士民相率請於朝，乃命趙師岩繼之。

translations.literal: Gentry and commoners together petitioned the court, and Zhao Shiyan was appointed to succeed him.
translations.idiomatic: Local elites and commoners petitioned the court together, and Zhao Shiyan was appointed to continue the work.

sentences.zh: 後二年，魏豹文代師岩為守，行之益力。

translations.literal: Two years later Wei Baowen replaced Shiyan as prefect and pursued it with greater force.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later Wei Baowen succeeded Shiyan as prefect and pushed the project harder still.

sentences.zh: 於是向之上戶析為貧下之戶，實田隱為逃絕之田者，粲然可考。

translations.literal: Thus households formerly registered as wealthy that were split into poor and lower households, and fields actually present but concealed as abandoned and extinct, became clearly verifiable.
translations.idiomatic: Households that had been registered as wealthy were reclassified as poor or lower-status, and fields that had been hidden as abandoned were brought plainly to light.

sentences.zh: 凡結甲冊、戶產簿、丁口簿、魚鱗圖、類姓簿二十三萬九千有奇，創庫匱以藏之，曆三年而後上其事於朝。

translations.literal: In all, household registers, property books, population registers, fish-scale maps, and clan registers totaled more than 239,000; storehouses were created to house them, and only after three years was the matter reported to the court.
translations.idiomatic: They compiled more than 239,000 household registers, property rolls, population lists, fish-scale maps, and clan records, built vaults to store them, and reported the results to court only after three years.

sentences.zh: 淳祐二年九月，敕曰：“四川累經兵火，百姓棄業避難，官以其曠土權耕屯以給軍食，及民歸業，占據不還。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Chunyou an edict said: "Sichuan has repeatedly suffered warfare; the people abandoned their occupations to flee; officials used its vacant land for temporary garrison farming to supply army grain; when the people returned to their occupations it was seized and not returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Chunyou 2 an edict declared: "Sichuan has been ravaged again and again by war. People fled their livelihoods for safety. Officials put idle land under temporary garrison cultivation to feed the armies; when the people came back, that land was held and not returned.

sentences.zh: 自今凡民有契券，界至分明，析在州縣屯官隨即歸還。

translations.literal: Henceforth wherever the people hold deeds with clear boundaries, land registered under prefectural and county garrison officials shall be returned at once.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, wherever commoners hold contracts with clear boundaries, any land listed under prefectural or county garrison offices must be returned immediately.

sentences.zh: 其有違戾，許民越訴，重罪之。

translations.literal: For those who violate this, the people are permitted to lodge appeals above, and offenders shall be heavily punished.
translations.idiomatic: Violators may be appealed against directly to higher authority, and shall be punished severely.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 六年，殿中侍御史兼侍講謝方叔言：

translations.literal: In the sixth year Palace Attendant remonstrator and lecturer Xie Fangshu said:
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 Palace Attendant remonstrator and imperial lecturer Xie Fangshu said:

sentences.zh: “豪強兼並之患，至今日而極，非限民名田有所不可，是亦救世道之微權也。

translations.literal: "The calamity of powerful families' annexation has today reached its extreme; nothing will do but limiting land per household—this too is a slight expedient to save the moral order.
translations.idiomatic: "The plague of powerful landlords swallowing fields has reached its peak. Nothing less than a ceiling on household landholding will do—and even that is only a small emergency measure to shore up the moral order.

sentences.zh: 國朝駐蹕錢塘，百有二十餘年矣。

translations.literal: The dynasty has resided at Qiantang for more than 120 years.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty has made its seat at Qiantang for more than a hundred and twenty years.

sentences.zh: 外之境土日荒，內之生齒日繁，權勢之家日盛，兼並之習日滋，百姓日貧，經製日壞，上下煎迫，若有不可為之勢。

translations.literal: Without the borders grow waste day by day, within the population multiplies day by day, powerful houses flourish day by day, the habit of annexation grows day by day, the people grow poor day by day, the regulatory system decays day by day; above and below are pressed as if in an impossible situation.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier lands waste away while the population inside grows; powerful families rise, annexation spreads, the people grow poorer, and the regulatory framework rots. Court and country are squeezed as though nothing can be done.

sentences.zh: 所謂富貴操柄者，若非人主之所得專，識者懼焉。

translations.literal: The so-called wealthy who hold the levers, if not solely at the sovereign's disposal, those with insight will fear.
translations.idiomatic: When the rich who control the levers of power are no longer fully at the ruler's command, thoughtful men grow afraid.

sentences.zh: 夫百萬生靈資生養之具，皆本於穀粟，而穀粟之產，皆出於田。

translations.literal: The means by which millions live all rest on grain, and grain's production all comes from fields.
translations.idiomatic: Millions depend for their living on grain, and grain comes from the fields.

sentences.zh: 今百姓膏腴皆歸貴勢之家，租米有及百萬石者；

translations.literal: Now the people's fertile land all goes to noble and powerful households, with rent grain reaching a million shi;
translations.idiomatic: Today the best farmland belongs to the great and powerful, and some landlords collect rent of a million shi of grain;

sentences.zh: 少民百畝之田，頻年差充保役，官吏誅求百端，不得已，則獻其產於巨室，以規免役。

translations.literal: petty people with fields of a hundred mu, year after year drafted for community militia service, officials extorting in countless ways, with no recourse, then offer their property to great houses to seek exemption from service.
translations.idiomatic: smallholders with a hundred mu face corvee year after year and endless official exactions; with no way out, they surrender their land to great estates to escape service.

sentences.zh: 小民田日減而保役不休，大官田日增而保役不及。

translations.literal: Petty people's fields diminish daily while militia service never ceases; great officials' fields increase daily while militia service never reaches them.
translations.idiomatic: Smallholders lose land daily yet corvee never stops; great landlords add land daily yet corvee never touches them.

sentences.zh: 以此弱之肉，強之食，兼並浸盛，民無以遂其生。

translations.literal: With the weak as meat and the strong as eater, annexation daily grows; the people have no way to make their living.
translations.idiomatic: The weak are devoured by the strong, annexation spreads, and commoners can no longer survive.

sentences.zh: 於斯時也，可不嚴立經製以為之防乎？

translations.literal: At such a time, can one not strictly establish the regulatory system as a defense?
translations.idiomatic: At such a moment, can the state afford not to set a firm regulatory fence?

sentences.zh: 去年，諫官嚐以限田為說，朝廷付之悠悠。

translations.literal: Last year remonstrators once urged limiting fields; the court set it aside.
translations.idiomatic: Last year remonstrators proposed land limits, but the court let the matter drift.

sentences.zh: 不知今日國用邊餉，皆仰和糴。

translations.literal: They do not realize that today's state expenses and frontier provisions all depend on government grain purchase.
translations.idiomatic: They fail to see that state revenue and frontier rations now depend entirely on government grain purchase.

sentences.zh: 然權勢多田之家，和糴不容以加之，保役不容以及之。

translations.literal: Yet for powerful households with many fields, purchase cannot be imposed on them, nor militia service reach them.
translations.idiomatic: Yet great landlords with vast holdings escape both purchase quotas and corvee.

sentences.zh: 敵人睥睨於外，盜賊窺伺於內，居此之時，與其多田厚貲不可長保，曷若捐金助國共紓目前？

translations.literal: Enemies eye us from without, bandits watch from within; in such circumstances, rather than much land and great wealth that cannot long be kept, how much better to donate gold to aid the state and together ease the present strain?
translations.idiomatic: Enemies press from outside and bandits wait within. In such a time, why cling to broad estates and heavy wealth that cannot last, when donating gold to the state would relieve the immediate crisis for everyone?

sentences.zh: 在轉移而開導之耳。

translations.literal: It lies in shifting and guiding them.
translations.idiomatic: What is needed is to turn their minds and lead them toward it.

sentences.zh: 乞諭二三大臣，摭臣僚論奏而行之，使經製以定，兼並以塞，於以尊朝廷，於以裕國計。

translations.literal: I beg that the chief ministers be instructed to gather officials' memorials and act, so the regulatory system is fixed and annexation stopped, thereby honoring the court and enriching state plans.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the chief ministers be told to collect officials' proposals and put them into practice, fixing the regulatory system, blocking annexation, strengthening the throne, and easing the treasury.

sentences.zh: 陛下勿牽貴近之言以搖初意，大臣勿避仇怨之多而廢良策，則天下幸甚。

translations.literal: Let Your Majesty not be swayed by the words of the noble and near to shake your first intent; let chief ministers not avoid many enemies to abandon good policy—then all under Heaven will be greatly fortunate.
translations.idiomatic: Let Your Majesty not let the counsel of the powerful at court shake your first resolve; let the chief ministers not abandon a sound policy for fear of enemies—then the realm will be greatly blessed.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月，敕曰：“監司、州縣不許非法估籍民產，戒非不嚴，而貪官暴吏，往往不問所犯輕重，不顧同居有分財產，一例估籍，殃及平民。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eleventh year an edict said: "Circuit intendants and prefectural officials are forbidden to illegally appraise and register people's property; prohibitions are not lax, yet greedy and violent officials often disregard whether the offense is light or heavy, ignore communal households' shared estates, appraise and register all alike, and harm commoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 11 an edict declared: "Circuit and prefectural officials must not illegally appraise and seize civilian property. The ban is strict, yet greedy and brutal officers often ignore the severity of the offense, disregard jointly held family estates, seize everything alike, and ruin ordinary people.

sentences.zh: 或戶絕之家不與命繼；

translations.literal: Or in households extinct there is no appointment of heirs;
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes extinct households are denied lawful heirs;

sentences.zh: 或經陳訴許以給還，輒假他名支破，竟成幹沒；

translations.literal: or after petition it is permitted to return, yet another name is borrowed to disburse and it ends as seizure;
translations.idiomatic: sometimes restitution is promised after appeal, only for funds to be disbursed under another name and embezzled;

sentences.zh: 或有典業不聽收贖，遂使產主無辜失業。

translations.literal: or mortgaged property is not permitted redemption, so owners innocently lose their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: sometimes mortgaged property cannot be redeemed, leaving innocent owners destitute.

sentences.zh: 違戾官吏，重置典憲。

translations.literal: Officials who violate this shall be heavily punished according to statute.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who violate this shall face the full weight of the law.

sentences.zh: ”是歲，信常饒州、嘉興府舉行經界。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. That year Xin, Chang, Raozhou and Jiaxing prefecture carried out land-boundary registration.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xinzhou, Changzhou, Raozhou, and Jiaxing carried out land-boundary surveys.

sentences.zh: 咸淳元年，監察御史趙順孫言：“經界將以便民，雖窮閻下戶之所深願，而未必豪宗大姓之所盡樂。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianchun Supervising Censor Zhao Shunsun said: "Land-boundary registration is to benefit the people; though the poorest lanes' lower households deeply wish it, it is not necessarily what great clans wholly welcome.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianchun 1 Supervising Censor Zhao Shunsun said: "Land-boundary registration is meant to help the people. The poorest households want it deeply, but great clans may not welcome it at all.

sentences.zh: 自非有以深服其心，則亦何以使其情意之悉孚哉？

translations.literal: Unless there is means deeply to win their hearts, how can their feelings be fully trusted?
translations.idiomatic: Unless they are truly won over, how can their goodwill be fully secured?

sentences.zh: 且今之所謂推排，非昔之所謂自實也。

translations.literal: Moreover what is now called pushed reassessment is not what was formerly called self-reporting.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, today's "pushed reassessment" is not the old "self-reporting."

sentences.zh: 推排者，委之鄉都，則徑捷而易行；

translations.literal: For pushed reassessment, entrust it to the village chief and it is direct, quick, and easy to carry out;
translations.idiomatic: With pushed reassessment, entrust the work to village chiefs and it is swift and easy;

sentences.zh: 自實者，責之於人戶，則散漫而難集。

translations.literal: for self-reporting, charge each household and it is scattered and hard to assemble.
translations.idiomatic: with self-reporting, burden each household and the effort is scattered and hard to complete.

sentences.zh: 嘉定以來之經界，時至近也，官有正籍，鄉都有副籍，彪列戶分，莫不具在，為鄉都者不過按成牘而更業主之姓名。

translations.literal: The Jiading land registration is quite recent: officials have the main register, village chiefs have duplicate registers, household divisions all listed—village chiefs need only follow completed documents and change owners' names.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiading survey is recent: officials hold the main register, village chiefs hold copies, and household divisions are all on file. Chiefs need only update the owner's name on existing documents.

sentences.zh: 若夫紹興之經界，其時則遠矣，其籍之存者寡矣。

translations.literal: As for the Shaoxing land registration, that time is far off and few registers survive.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaoxing survey lies far in the past, and few registers survive.

sentences.zh: 因其鱗差櫛比而求焉，由一而至百，由百而至千，由千而至萬，稽其畝步，訂其主佃，亦莫如鄉都之便也。

translations.literal: Tracing through their fish-scale rankings from one to a hundred, hundred to a thousand, thousand to ten thousand, checking mu and pace, fixing owners and tenants—nothing is as convenient as the village chief.
translations.idiomatic: Rebuilding from fish-scale maps one by one, ten by ten, a thousand by a thousand, checking acreage and boundaries and fixing owners and tenants—nothing is easier than working through the village chiefs.

sentences.zh: 朱熹所以主經界而辟自實者，正謂是也。

translations.literal: Zhu Xi therefore upheld land boundaries and rejected self-reporting—he meant precisely this.
translations.idiomatic: That is why Zhu Xi favored land-boundary registration and opposed self-reporting.

sentences.zh: 州縣能守朝廷鄉都任責之令，又隨諸州之便宜而為之區處，當必人情之悉孚，不令而行矣。

translations.literal: If prefectures and counties can obey the court's order charging village chiefs with responsibility, and also adapt to each prefecture's convenience in arranging matters, popular feeling will surely be fully won and it will proceed without orders.
translations.idiomatic: If prefectures and counties enforce the court's charge to village chiefs and adapt methods to local conditions, the people will be won over and the work will go forward without coercion.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 三年，司農卿兼戶部侍郎李鏞言：“夫經界嚐議修明矣，而修明卒不行；

translations.literal: In the third year Minister of Agriculture and acting Vice Minister of Revenue Li Yong said: "Land boundaries were once debated for thorough clarification, yet clarification in the end did not proceed;
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 Minister of Agriculture and acting Revenue Vice Minister Li Yong said: "Land-boundary reform has been debated many times, yet never fully carried out;

sentences.zh: 嚐令自實矣，而自實卒不竟。

translations.literal: self-reporting was once ordered, yet self-reporting in the end was not completed.
translations.idiomatic: self-reporting was once ordered, yet never finished.

sentences.zh: 豈非上之任事者每欲避理財之名，下之不樂其成者又每倡為擾民之說。

translations.literal: Is it not that superiors in charge often wish to avoid the name of managing finances, while those below unwilling to see completion again raise the claim of troubling the people.
translations.idiomatic: Is it not because superiors shun the label of "managing finances," while local interests that oppose success cry that the people are being harassed.

sentences.zh: 故寧坐視邑政之壞，而不敢詰猾吏奸民之欺；

translations.literal: Thus they would rather sit by as local government decays than dare to pursue crafty clerks and cheating subjects;
translations.idiomatic: They would rather watch local government rot than confront corrupt clerks and cheating landowners;

sentences.zh: 寧忍取下戶之苛，而不敢受豪家大姓之怨。

translations.literal: rather endure harshness on lower households than dare incur great clans' resentment.
translations.idiomatic: rather squeeze poor households than provoke great clans.

sentences.zh: 蓋經界之法，必多差官吏，必悉集都保，必遍走阡陌，必盡量步畝，必審定等色，必紐折計等，奸弊轉生，久不迄事。

translations.literal: For the land-boundary law requires many assigned officials, must fully gather community militia units, must traverse every field path, must fully measure pace and mu, must carefully fix grades, must tie and fold accounts—frauds multiply and long the task is not finished.
translations.idiomatic: The old boundary law demands armies of officials, full musters of militia units, surveys of every path, measurement of every field, grading of every plot, and tangled accounting—fraud flourishes and the work never ends.

sentences.zh: 乃若推排之法，不過以縣統都，以都統保，選任才富公平者，訂田畝稅色，載之圖冊，使民有定產，產有定稅，稅有定籍而已。

translations.literal: But the pushed-reassessment method merely uses the county to oversee districts, districts to oversee militia units, selects capable and fair wealthy men, fixes field mu and tax grades, records them in maps and registers, so people have fixed property, property fixed tax, tax fixed register—that is all.
translations.idiomatic: Pushed reassessment simply lets the county supervise districts and districts supervise militia units, appoints capable and fair men, fixes acreage and tax grades, records them in registers, and gives every household fixed property, fixed tax, and fixed registration—that is all.

sentences.zh: 臣守吳門，巳嚐見之施行。

translations.literal: I guarded the Wu gates and have seen it implemented.
translations.idiomatic: In my tenure at the Wu prefecture I have seen it work.

sentences.zh: 今聞紹興亦漸就緒，湖南漕臣亦以一路告成。

translations.literal: Now I hear Shaoxing is also gradually nearing completion, and the Hunan transport commissioner reports the whole circuit finished.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing is reportedly nearing completion, and the Hunan transport commissioner says his entire circuit is done.

sentences.zh: 竊謂東南諸郡，皆奉行惟謹。

translations.literal: I venture to say the southeastern prefectures all observe with strict care.
translations.idiomatic: I believe the southeastern prefectures are all carrying it out diligently.

sentences.zh: 其或田畝未實，則令鄉局厘正之；

translations.literal: If field mu are not verified, order the village office to correct them;
translations.idiomatic: Where acreage is wrong, the village office should correct it;

sentences.zh: 圖冊未備，則令縣局程督之。

translations.literal: if maps and registers are not complete, order the county office to press them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: where maps and registers are incomplete, the county office should press for completion.

sentences.zh: 又必郡守察縣之稽違，監司察郡之怠弛，嚴其號令，信其賞罰，期之秋冬以竟其事，責之年歲以課其成，如《周官》日成、月要、歲會以綜核之。

translations.literal: Further, prefects must inspect counties' delays, circuit intendants inspect prefectures' laxity, make orders strict and rewards and punishments trusted, set autumn-winter to finish the task, charge yearly harvest to test completion, like the 《Zhou Offices》 daily accomplishment, monthly summary, yearly reckoning for comprehensive audit.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects must watch counties for delay, intendants must watch prefectures for slackness, orders must be strict and rewards and punishments reliable, autumn and winter set as the deadline, and yearly harvest as the test of completion—just as the 《Zhou Offices》 uses daily results, monthly reports, and yearly reckoning for oversight.

sentences.zh: ”於是詔諸路漕、帥施行焉。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon an edict ordered all circuits' transport and military commissioners to implement it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered every circuit's transport and military commissioners to carry it out.

sentences.zh: 大抵南渡後水田之利，富於中原，故水利大興。

translations.literal: Generally after the Southern Crossing, the profit of paddy fields in the south exceeded the Central Plains, so waterworks flourished.
translations.idiomatic: After the southward relocation, paddy-field yields in the south surpassed those of the north, and hydraulic works flourished.

sentences.zh: 而諸籍沒田募民耕者，皆仍私租舊額，每失之重，輸納之際，公私事例迥殊。

translations.literal: Yet for all confiscated fields recruiting people to farm, old private rent quotas were still used, each time too heavy; at payment the public and private precedents were wholly different.
translations.idiomatic: Yet tenants on confiscated land still paid old private-rent rates that were often too high, and at collection time public and private rules diverged sharply.

sentences.zh: 私租額重而納輕，承佃猶可；

translations.literal: Private rent quota heavy but payment light, tenants could still bear it;
translations.idiomatic: Private rents were high on paper but light in collection, so tenants could still manage;

sentences.zh: 公租額重而納重，則佃不堪命。

translations.literal: public rent quota heavy and payment heavy, then tenants could not sustain it.
translations.idiomatic: public rents were high on paper and heavy in collection, and tenants could not endure them.

sentences.zh: 州縣胥吏與倉庾百執事之人，皆得為侵漁之道於耕者也。

translations.literal: Prefectural clerks and granary attendants alike had ways to prey on those who farmed.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural clerks and granary staff alike found ways to squeeze the cultivators.

sentences.zh: 季世金人乍和乍戰，戰則軍需浩繁，和則歲幣重大，國用常苦不繼，於是因民苦官租之重，命有司括賣官田以給用。

translations.literal: In the dynasty's late years the Jurchens alternated peace and war; in war military needs were vast, in peace yearly tribute was heavy—state funds often ran short; therefore because people suffered the weight of official rent, authorities were ordered to catalogue and sell official fields to supply use.
translations.idiomatic: In the dynasty's final decades the Jurchens swung between peace and war. War brought vast military costs; peace brought heavy annual tribute. The treasury was often empty, so because people groaned under official rents, the state ordered official fields catalogued and sold to meet expenses.

sentences.zh: 其初弛其力役以誘之，其終不免於抑配，此官田之弊也。

translations.literal: At first corvee was relaxed to lure them; in the end they could not escape forced allotment—this was the defect of official fields.
translations.idiomatic: At first labor duties were eased to entice buyers; in the end purchasers could not escape forced quotas—such were the abuses of official land sales.

sentences.zh: 嘉定以後，又有所謂安邊所田，收其租以助歲幣。

translations.literal: After Jiading there was also so-called frontier-pacification office land, collecting its rent to aid yearly tribute.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiading came so-called frontier-pacification office land, whose rents helped pay annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 至其將亡，又限民名田，買其限外所有，謂之公田。

translations.literal: Near its fall, land per household was again limited, and holdings beyond the limit were bought—called public fields.
translations.idiomatic: Near the dynasty's fall, household land limits were imposed again and excess holdings were bought up as "public fields."

sentences.zh: 初議欲省和糴以紓民力，而其弊極多，其租尤重；

translations.literal: At first the plan hoped to save government purchase and ease people's strength, but its abuses were extreme and its rent especially heavy;
translations.idiomatic: The plan was meant to reduce government grain purchase and ease the people, but abuses multiplied and rents were especially crushing;

sentences.zh: 宋亡，遺患猶不息也。

translations.literal: after Song fell the lingering harm still did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: and after the Song fell the harm did not end.

sentences.zh: 凡水田、官田之法，公田見於史者，彙其始末而悉載於篇，有足鑒者焉。

translations.literal: In all, for paddy fields and official-field laws, and public fields appearing in the histories, beginning and end are gathered and fully recorded in this section—there is matter worth reflecting on.
translations.idiomatic: The laws governing paddy land, official fields, and public fields recorded in history are gathered here from beginning to end—material well worth heeding.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，詔宣州、太平州守臣修圩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing an edict ordered Xuan and Taiping prefectures' officials to repair dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 1 an edict ordered the prefects of Xuanzhou and Taiping to repair the dikes.

sentences.zh: 二年，以修圩錢米及貸民種糧，並於宣州常平、義倉米撥借。

translations.literal: In the second year funds and grain for dike repair and loans of seed to people were all advanced from Xuanzhou's ever-normal and righteous-granary grain.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 dike-repair funds, grain, and seed loans were all drawn from Xuanzhou's ever-normal and righteous-granary stocks.

sentences.zh: 三年，定州縣圩田租額充軍儲。

translations.literal: In the third year fixed prefectural and county dike-field rent quotas to fill army stores.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 rent quotas on dike fields were fixed to supply military stores.

sentences.zh: 建康府永豐圩租米，歲以三萬石為額。

translations.literal: For Jianchang prefecture's Yongfeng dike rent grain, the yearly quota was 30,000 shi.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongfeng dike in Jianchang prefecture was assessed 30,000 shi of rent grain per year.

sentences.zh: 圩四至相去皆五六十里，有田九百五十餘頃，近歲墾田不及三之一。

translations.literal: The dike's four bounds were each fifty or sixty li apart, with fields of more than 950 qing; in recent years reclaimed fields did not reach a third.
translations.idiomatic: The dike stretched fifty or sixty li on each side and held more than 950 qing of land, though recent reclamation had reached less than a third of that.

sentences.zh: 至是，始立額。

translations.literal: At this point the quota was first established.
translations.idiomatic: Only then was the quota set.

sentences.zh: 五年，江東帥臣李光言：“明、越之境，皆有陂湖，大抵湖高於田，田又高於江、海。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Jiangdong military commissioner Li Guang said: "In Ming and Yue territories there are all reservoir lakes; generally the lake is higher than the fields, the fields higher than the rivers and sea.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 Jiangdong military commissioner Li Guang said: "In Ming and Yue there are reservoir lakes everywhere. As a rule the lake lies above the fields, and the fields above the rivers and sea.

sentences.zh: 旱則放湖水溉田，澇則決田水入海，故無水旱之災。

translations.literal: In drought lake water is released to irrigate fields; in flood field water is discharged to the sea—thus there were no flood or drought disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In drought the lakes irrigate the fields; in flood the fields drain into the sea. That is why the region once knew neither flood nor drought.

sentences.zh: 本朝慶曆、嘉祐間，始有盜湖為田者，其禁甚嚴。

translations.literal: During our dynasty's Qingli and Jiayou periods there first were those who stole lakes for fields; the prohibition was very strict.
translations.idiomatic: Under our dynasty, in the Qingli and Jiayou eras, people first began encroaching on lakes for farmland, and the ban was strict.

sentences.zh: 政和以來，創為應奉，始廢湖為田。

translations.literal: Since the Zhenghe era, tribute offices were created and lakes were first abandoned for fields.
translations.idiomatic: From the Zhenghe era onward, tribute agencies were set up and lakes were turned into fields.

sentences.zh: 自是兩州之民，歲被水旱之患。

translations.literal: From then the people of both prefectures yearly suffered flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: Since then the people of both prefectures have suffered floods and droughts every year.

sentences.zh: 餘姚、上虞每縣收租不過數千斛，而所失民田常賦，動以萬計。

translations.literal: Yuyao and Shangyu each collected no more than several thousand hu rent, while lost regular fields' taxes often ran to tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Yuyao and Shangyu each collect only a few thousand hu in rent, while the regular taxes lost from ruined farmland run to tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 莫若先罷兩邑湖田。

translations.literal: Best first to abolish the two counties' lake fields.
translations.idiomatic: The best course is to abolish the lake fields in those two counties first.

sentences.zh: ”其會稽之鑒湖、鄞之廣德湖、蕭山之湘湖等處尚多，望詔漕臣盡廢之。

translations.literal: "Moreover, at Kuaiji's Mirror Lake, Yin's Guangde Lake, Xiaoshan's Xiang Lake and elsewhere there are still many; it is hoped the transport commissioner may abolish them all.
translations.idiomatic: Mirror Lake at Kuaiji, Guangde Lake in Yin, Xiang Lake in Xiaoshan, and others still remain in large numbers. I ask that the transport commissioner abolish them all.

sentences.zh: 其江東、西圩田，蘇、秀圍田，令監司守令條上。

translations.literal: For Jiangdong and Jiangxi dike fields, Su and Xiu embanked fields, order circuit intendants and prefects to itemize and submit.
translations.idiomatic: For dike fields in Jiangdong and Jiangxi and embanked fields in Suzhou and Xiuzhou, circuit intendants and prefects should submit detailed reports.

sentences.zh: ”於是詔諸路漕臣議之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon an edict ordered all circuits' transport commissioners to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered transport commissioners in every circuit to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 其後議者雖稱合廢，竟仍其舊。

translations.literal: Later deliberators though said abolition was fitting, in the end the old state remained.
translations.idiomatic: Later deliberations favored abolition, but in the end the old arrangements remained.

sentences.zh: 初，五代馬氏於潭州東二十里，因諸山之泉，築堤瀦水，號曰龜塘，溉田萬頃。

translations.literal: Initially in the Five Dynasties the Ma clan at Chatan, twenty li east of the prefecture, dammed the mountain springs, storing water called Turtle Pond, irrigating ten thousand qing.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Five Dynasties the Ma clan, twenty li east of Tanzhou, dammed mountain springs into a reservoir called Turtle Pond that irrigated ten thousand qing.

sentences.zh: 其後堤壞，歲旱，民皆阻饑。

translations.literal: Later the dike broke; in years of drought the people all suffered hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Later the dike failed; in drought years the people starved.

sentences.zh: 七年，守臣呂頤浩始募民修復，以廣耕稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the prefect Lü Yihao first recruited people to repair and expand cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 the prefect Lü Yihao first recruited labor to repair it and expand cultivation.

sentences.zh: 十六年，知袁州張成巳言：“江西良田，多占山岡，望委守令講陂塘灌溉之利。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Yuan prefect Zhang Chengji said: "In Jiangxi fertile fields mostly occupy mountain ridges; it is hoped prefects and magistrates may discuss the profit of reservoirs and irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 Yuanzhou prefect Zhang Chengji said: "In Jiangxi good farmland often lies on hillsides. I ask that prefects and magistrates be ordered to promote reservoir irrigation.

sentences.zh: ”其後比部員外郎李滬言，淮西高原處舊有陂塘，請給錢米，以時修浚。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Later Bureau of Review vice director Li Hu said on the Huaixi highlands there were old reservoirs—please grant funds and grain to repair them on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Later Review Bureau vice director Li Hu said that old reservoirs on the Huaixi highlands should receive funds and grain for timely repair.

sentences.zh: 知江陰軍蔣及祖亦請浚治本軍五卸溝以泄水，修復橫河支渠以溉旱。

translations.literal: Jiangyin army commander Jiang Jizu also asked to dredge this army's Five Discharge Ditch to drain water and restore branch channels of the Horizontal River to irrigate drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangyin commander Jiang Jizu also asked to dredge the army's Five Discharge Ditch for drainage and restore branch channels of the Horizontal River to irrigate dry fields.

sentences.zh: 乃並詔諸路常平司行之，每季以施行聞。

translations.literal: All were ordered to the circuits' ever-normal offices to implement; each season report on execution.
translations.idiomatic: All were ordered carried out by the circuits' ever-normal offices, with quarterly progress reports.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，諫議大夫史才言：“浙西、民田最廣，而平時無甚害者，太湖之利也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year remonstrance doctor Shi Cai said: "West Zhe—the people's fields are most extensive, and in normal times there is little harm because of Tai Lake's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 Remonstrance Doctor Shi Cai said: "In western Zhe the people's fields are vast, and in ordinary times they suffer little harm because of Tai Lake.

sentences.zh: 近年瀕湖之地，多為兵卒侵據，累土增高，長堤彌望，名曰壩田。

translations.literal: In recent years lakeside land has mostly been seized by soldiers, piling earth to raise it, long dikes stretching—called dam fields.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years lakeshore land has mostly been seized by soldiers, who piled earth into long dikes called dam fields.

sentences.zh: 旱則據之以溉，而民田不沾其利；

translations.literal: In drought they seize it to irrigate while people's fields do not share the benefit;
translations.idiomatic: In drought they use it to irrigate while ordinary fields receive no benefit;

sentences.zh: 澇則遠近泛濫，不得入湖，而民田盡沒。

translations.literal: In flood the near and far overflow broadly, cannot enter the lake, and the people's fields are all submerged.
translations.idiomatic: In flood season waters spread everywhere and cannot drain into the lake, and the people's fields are wholly inundated.

sentences.zh: 望盡復太湖舊跡，使軍民各安，田疇均利。

translations.literal: I hope to fully restore Tai Lake's former extent, so that soldiers and civilians each find security and fields share equal benefit.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Tai Lake be fully restored to its former bounds, so soldiers and civilians alike may live in peace and the fields share the benefit equally.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The court followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted his proposal.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，大理寺丞周環言：“臨安、平江、湖、秀四州下田，多為積水所浸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Dali Temple vice director Zhou Huan said: "In Lin'an, Pingjiang, Hu, and Xiu the four prefectures' low fields are mostly soaked by standing water.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 Dali Temple Vice Director Zhou Huan said: "In Lin'an, Pingjiang, Huzhou, and Xiuzhou the low-lying fields are largely submerged by standing water.

sentences.zh: 緣溪山諸水並歸太湖，自太湖分二派：東南一派由鬆江入於海，東北一派由諸浦注之江。

translations.literal: Along the hills the various streams all return to Tai Lake; from Tai Lake they divide into two branches: the southeast branch enters the sea through Songjiang, the northeast branch is poured into the Yangzi through various sluices.
translations.idiomatic: The hill streams all converge on Tai Lake, which then divides into two branches: the southeastern branch flows to the sea through Songjiang, and the northeastern branch is discharged into the Yangzi through various water mouths.

sentences.zh: 其鬆江泄水，惟白茅一浦最大。

translations.literal: Of Songjiang's drainage of water, only the Baimao sluice is largest.
translations.idiomatic: Of Songjiang's outlets for draining the lake, the Baimao sluice alone is the largest.

sentences.zh: 今泥沙淤塞，宜決浦故道，俾水勢分派流暢，實四州無窮之利。

translations.literal: Now silt and sand are choked and blocked; it is fitting to open the sluices' old channels, so that the water's force may divide and flow freely—truly an inexhaustible benefit to the four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Silt has now choked them shut. The old sluice channels should be reopened so the water may divide and run freely—a benefit to the four prefectures without end.

sentences.zh: ”詔兩浙漕臣視之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict ordered the Two Zhe transport commissioners to inspect it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Two Zhe transport commissioners to inspect the situation.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，兩浙轉運副使趙子潚、知平江府蔣璨言：“太湖者，數州之巨浸，而獨泄以鬆江之一川，宜其勢有所不逮。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Two Zhe transport vice commissioner Zhao Zishe and Pingjiang prefect Jiang Can said: "Tai Lake is a great flood basin of several prefectures, yet it drains solely through Songjiang's one channel—no wonder its force cannot keep pace.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 Two Zhe Transport Vice Commissioner Zhao Zishe and Pingjiang Prefect Jiang Can said: "Tai Lake is the great reservoir of several prefectures, yet it drains through Songjiang alone—small wonder its force cannot keep up.

sentences.zh: 是以昔人於常熟之北開二十四浦，疏而導之江；

translations.literal: Therefore men of old north of Changshu opened twenty-four sluices, dredged them, and led them to the Yangzi;
translations.idiomatic: For this reason men of old opened twenty-four sluices north of Changshu, dredged them, and led the water to the Yangzi;

sentences.zh: 又於昆山之東開一十二浦，分而納之海。

translations.literal: and east of Kunshan opened twelve sluices, dividing the flow and pouring it into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: and east of Kunshan opened twelve more, dividing the flow and discharging it into the sea.

sentences.zh: 三十六浦後為潮汐沙積，而開江之卒亦廢，於是民田有淹沒之患。

translations.literal: The thirty-six sluices afterward were silted by tidal sand, and the troops who opened the river channels were also disbanded; thus the people's fields suffered inundation.
translations.idiomatic: The thirty-six sluices were later choked by tidal sand, and the river-opening corps was disbanded as well, so the people's fields came under threat of flooding.

sentences.zh: 天聖間，漕臣張綸嚐於常熟、昆山各開眾浦；

translations.literal: In the Tiansheng era transport commissioner Zhang Lun once at Changshu and Kunshan each opened many sluices;
translations.idiomatic: During the Tiansheng era Transport Commissioner Zhang Lun once opened many sluices at Changshu and Kunshan;

sentences.zh: 景祐間，郡守範仲淹亦親至海浦，浚開五河；

translations.literal: in the Jingyou era the prefect Fan Zhongyan also personally went to the coastal sluices and dredged open five rivers;
translations.idiomatic: in the Jingyou era Prefect Fan Zhongyan went in person to the coastal outlets and dredged open five rivers;

sentences.zh: 政和間提舉官趙霖復嚐開浚。

translations.literal: in the Zhenghe era intendant Zhao Lin again once opened and dredged.
translations.idiomatic: and in the Zhenghe era Intendant Zhao Lin undertook dredging once again.

sentences.zh: 今諸浦湮塞，又非前比，計用工三百三十餘萬，錢三十三萬餘緡，米十萬餘斛。

translations.literal: Now the various sluices are choked and blocked, and the situation is worse than before; it is estimated to require more than 3.3 million labor units, more than 330,000 strings of cash, and more than 100,000 bushels of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Today the sluices are choked shut and the situation is worse than ever. The work is estimated at more than 3.3 million labor units, 330,000 strings of cash, and 100,000 bushels of grain.

sentences.zh: ”於是詔監察御史任古復視之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon an edict ordered investigating censor Ren Gu to inspect again.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered Investigating Censor Ren Gu to inspect the project again.

sentences.zh: 既而古至平江言：“常熟五浦通江誠便，若依所請，以五千功，月餘可畢。

translations.literal: Soon after Gu arrived at Pingjiang and said: "The five Changshu sluices leading to the Yangzi are truly convenient; if carried out as requested, with five thousand labor units it can be finished in a little over a month.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Gu soon reached Pingjiang and reported: "Opening the five Changshu sluices into the Yangzi is genuinely advantageous; if the request is followed, five thousand labor units should finish the work in little more than a month.

sentences.zh: ”詔以激賞庫錢、平江府上供米如數給之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict ordered funds from the Stimulation Reward Treasury and Pingjiang's tribute grain supplied in the requested amounts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict supplied the Stimulation Reward Treasury funds and Pingjiang tribute grain in the amounts requested.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，子潚又言：“父老稱福山塘與丁涇地勢等，若不浚福山塘，則水必倒注於丁涇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Zishe again said: "The elders say Fushan Pond and Dingjing are equal in terrain; if Fushan Pond is not dredged, water will surely pour back into Dingjing.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 Zishe again said: "Local elders report that Fushan Pond and Dingjing lie at the same elevation; unless Fushan Pond is dredged, water will backflow into Dingjing.

sentences.zh: ”乃命並浚之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. He was ordered to dredge both together.
translations.idiomatic: Both were ordered dredged together.

sentences.zh: 隆興二年八月，詔：“江、浙水利，久不講修，勢家圍田，堙塞流水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of Longxing year 2 an edict said: "Jiangsu and Zhejiang waterworks have long gone without discussion and repair; powerful families' encircled fields block and choke the flow of water.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Longxing 2 an edict declared: "Water conservancy in Jiangsu and Zhejiang has long been neglected; powerful families' polder reclamations choke the waterways.

sentences.zh: 諸州守臣按視以聞。

translations.literal: Let prefectural officials in all prefectures inspect on site and report.
translations.idiomatic: Let prefects in every prefecture inspect on site and report.

sentences.zh: ”於是知湖州鄭作肅、知宣州許尹、知秀州姚憲、知常州劉唐稽並乞開圍田，浚港瀆。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon Huzhou prefect Zheng Zuosu, Xuanzhou prefect Xu Yin, Xiuzhou prefect Yao Xian, and Changzhou prefect Liu Tangji all begged to open encircled fields and dredge harbors and canals.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Huzhou Prefect Zheng Zuosu, Xuanzhou Prefect Xu Yin, Xiuzhou Prefect Yao Xian, and Changzhou Prefect Liu Tangji all petitioned to break open encircled fields and dredge harbors and canals.

sentences.zh: 詔湖州委朱夏卿，秀州委曾愭，平江府委陳彌作，常州、江陰軍委葉謙亨，宣州、太平州委沈樞措置。

translations.literal: An edict entrusted Huzhou to Zhu Xiaqing, Xiuzhou to Zeng Chi, Pingjiang to Chen Mizuo, Changzhou and Jiangyin Army to Ye Qianheng, and Xuanzhou and Taiping Prefecture to Shen Shu for arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: An edict assigned Huzhou to Zhu Xiaqing, Xiuzhou to Zeng Chi, Pingjiang to Chen Mizuo, Changzhou and Jiangyin to Ye Qianheng, and Xuanzhou and Taiping to Shen Shu to take charge.

sentences.zh: 九月，刑部侍郎吳芾言：“昨守紹興，嚐請開鑒湖廢田二百七十頃，復湖之舊，水無泛濫，民田九千餘頃，悉獲倍收。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Ministry of Justice vice minister Wu Bi said: "When I formerly governed Shaoxing I once asked to open two hundred seventy qing of abandoned fields on Mirror Lake, restore the lake's old state, keep water from flooding, and nine thousand-odd qing of people's fields all gained double harvests.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Vice Minister of Justice Wu Bi said: "When I governed Shaoxing I once petitioned to reopen 270 qing of abandoned fields on Mirror Lake and restore the lake to its former extent; flooding ceased, and more than 9,000 qing of fields doubled their yield.

sentences.zh: 今尚有低田二萬餘畝，本亦湖也，百姓交佃，畝直才兩三緡。

translations.literal: Now there remain more than twenty thousand mu of low fields that were originally also lake; common people rent them in turn, and the price per mu is only two or three strings.
translations.idiomatic: More than 20,000 mu of low fields that were once lakebed remain; tenants pay only two or three strings per mu.

sentences.zh: 欲官給其半，盡廢其田，去其租。

translations.literal: I wish the state to supply half, wholly abolish those fields, and remove their rent.
translations.idiomatic: I propose that the state pay half the value, abolish the fields entirely, and remit their rent.

sentences.zh: ”戶部請符浙東常平司同紹興府守臣審細標遷。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The Ministry of Revenue asked the Eastern Zhe ever-normal office together with Shaoxing's prefect to examine carefully and mark out relocation.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue asked the Eastern Zhe ever-normal office and the Shaoxing prefect to examine the plan carefully and mark the land for restoration.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年四月，詔漕臣王炎開浙西勢家新圍田，草蕩、荷蕩、菱蕩及陂湖溪港岸際旋築塍畦、圍裹耕種者，所至守令同共措置。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Qiandao year 2 an edict ordered transport commissioner Wang Yan to open the Two Zhe west powerful families' newly encircled fields—reed flats, lotus flats, water-chestnut flats, and along the banks of ponds, lakes, streams, and harbors where embankments and furrows were hastily built and wrapped for cultivation—wherever they reached, prefects and magistrates should jointly arrange matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Qiandao 2 an edict ordered Transport Commissioner Wang Yan to break open newly reclaimed polders of powerful families in western Zhe—reed flats, lotus flats, water-chestnut flats, and any pond, lake, stream, or harbor margin where dikes had been thrown up for cultivation—with local prefects and magistrates to act jointly.

sentences.zh: 炎既開諸圍田，凡租戶貸主家種糧債負，並奏蠲之。

translations.literal: After Yan had opened the various encircled fields, all tenant debts for seed grain borrowed from landlord households were memorialized for remission.
translations.idiomatic: Once the encircled fields were opened, Yan memorialized for the remission of all tenant debts for seed grain owed to landlord households.

sentences.zh: 六月，知秀州孫大雅代還，言：“州有柘湖、澱山湖、當湖、陳湖，支港相貫，西北可入於江，東南可達於海。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Xiuzhou prefect Sun Daya, returning after replacement, said: "The prefecture has Zhe Lake, Dianshan Lake, Dang Lake, and Chen Lake; branch harbors connect through them—northwest they can enter the Yangzi, southeast they can reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Xiuzhou Prefect Sun Daya, on returning from his post, said: "The prefecture has Zhe Lake, Dianshan Lake, Dang Lake, and Chen Lake, linked by branch channels that reach the Yangzi to the northwest and the sea to the southeast.

sentences.zh: 旁海農家作壩以卻堿潮，雖利及一方，而水患實害鄰郡；

translations.literal: Coastal farmers build dams to repel brackish tides; though the benefit reaches one locality, the water calamity truly harms neighboring prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: Coastal farmers build dams to hold back brackish tides, which may benefit one district but in truth harm neighboring prefectures with flooding;

sentences.zh: 設疏導之，則又害及旁海之田。

translations.literal: if one sets up drainage and guidance, then harm again reaches the coastal fields nearby.
translations.idiomatic: yet if drainage is opened, the coastal fields themselves suffer harm.

sentences.zh: 若於諸港浦置閘啟閉，不惟可以泄水，而旱亦獲利。

translations.literal: If at the various harbors and sluices sluice gates are installed to open and close, not only can water be drained, but in drought benefit is also gained.
translations.idiomatic: If sluice gates were installed at the harbors and outlets to regulate flow, floodwater could be discharged and drought would also bring benefit.

sentences.zh: 然工力稍大，欲率大姓出錢，下戶出力，於農隙修治之。

translations.literal: Yet the labor is somewhat great; I wish to lead great surnames to contribute money and lower households to contribute labor, and in the farming slack season repair and govern.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the labor is considerable; he proposed that wealthy clans supply funds and common households labor, repairing in the agricultural off-season.

sentences.zh: ”於是以兩浙轉運副使薑詵與守臣視之，詵尋與秀常州、平江府、江陰軍條上利便。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon Two Zhe transport vice commissioner Jiang Shen together with prefectural officials inspected on site; Shen soon together with Xiuzhou, Changzhou, Pingjiang Prefecture, and Jiangyin Army itemized advantages.
translations.idiomatic: Two Zhe Transport Vice Commissioner Jiang Shen then inspected with local officials and, with Xiuzhou, Changzhou, Pingjiang, and Jiangyin, submitted plans for each site.

sentences.zh: 詔：“秀州華亭縣張涇閘並澱山東北通陂塘港淺處，俟今年十一月興修；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Xiuzhou Huating County's Zhangjing sluice gate and the shallow places northeast of Dianshan connecting to Pogang Harbor shall be repaired starting this November;
