translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered repairs at Xiuzhou Huating's Zhangjing sluice and shallow reaches northeast of Dianshan linking Pogang Harbor, to begin that November;

sentences.zh: 江陰軍、常州蔡涇閘及申港，明年春興修；

translations.literal: Jiangyin Army, Changzhou Caijing sluice gate and Shen Harbor, to be repaired next spring;
translations.idiomatic: Jiangyin and Changzhou's Caijing sluice and Shen Harbor the following spring;

sentences.zh: 利港俟休役一年興修；

translations.literal: Ligang to be repaired after one year's corvée rest;
translations.idiomatic: Ligang after one year's corvée exemption;

sentences.zh: 平江府姑緩之。

translations.literal: Pingjiang Prefecture for the present to be deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang deferred for the present.

sentences.zh: ”三年三月，詵使還，奏：“開浚畢功，通泄積水，久浸民田露出塍岸。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. In the third month of year 3 Shen returned from his mission and memorialized: "Opening and dredging are fully completed; accumulated water is discharged; long-submerged people's fields have exposed embankments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 3 Shen reported: "Dredging is complete, stored water released, and long-flooded fields have re-emerged.

sentences.zh: 臣已諭民趁時耕種。

translations.literal: I have already instructed the people to seize the season and plant.
translations.idiomatic: He had urged the people to plant in season.

sentences.zh: 恐下戶闕本，良田復荒，望令浙西常平司貸給種糧。

translations.literal: Fearing lower households lack seed, good fields again lie waste—I hope the Western Zhe ever-normal office may lend seed grain.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing poor households lacked seed and good land would lie fallow again, he asked the Western Zhe ever-normal office to lend seed grain.

sentences.zh: ”又奏措置、提督、監修等官知江陰軍徐藏等減磨勘年有差。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. He also memorialized arrangement, supervision, and construction officials such as Jiangyin prefect Xu Zang and others with differing reductions in merit-review years.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards in merit review were also granted to supervisors including Jiangyin Prefect Xu Zang.

sentences.zh: 四年，以彭州守臣梁介修復三縣一十餘堰，灌溉之利及於鄰邦，詔介直秘閣、利路轉運判官。

translations.literal: In year 4, because Pengzhou prefectural official Liang Jie restored more than ten barrages in three counties, irrigation benefit reaching neighboring states, an edict advanced Jie to Secretariat Drafter and Li Road transport vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Pengzhou official Liang Jie restored more than ten barrages in three counties, benefiting neighboring prefectures; he was advanced to Secretariat Drafter and Liang Road transport vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七年，王炎言：“興元府山河堰世傳漢蕭、曹所作。

translations.literal: In year 7 Wang Yan said: "The Mountain River Barrage of Xingyuan Prefecture is handed down as the work of Han's Xiao and Cao.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Wang Yan said: "Xingyuan's Mountain River Barrage is traditionally attributed to the Han ministers Xiao and Cao.

sentences.zh: 本朝嘉祐中，提舉史炤上堰法，獲降敕書刻石堰上。

translations.literal: In our dynasty's Jiayou era intendant Shi Zhao submitted barrage methods and received an imperial edict carved on stone at the barrage.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiayou era Intendant Shi Zhao submitted barrage regulations and received an edict carved in stone at the site.

sentences.zh: 紹興以來，戶口凋疏，堰事荒廢，遂委知興元府吳拱修復，發卒萬人助役。

translations.literal: Since the Shaoxing era households have declined and barrage affairs fallen into ruin; it was entrusted to Xingyuan prefect Wu Gong to restore, sending ten thousand troops to assist labor.
translations.idiomatic: Since Shaoxing the population has declined and the works decayed; Xingyuan Prefect Wu Gong was ordered to restore them with ten thousand laborers.

sentences.zh: 宣撫司及安撫、都統司共用錢三萬一千餘緡，盡修六堰，浚大小渠六十五里，凡溉南鄭、褒城田二十三萬三千畝有奇。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commission and Pacification and Commander-in-chief offices together used more than thirty-one thousand strings; all six barrages were repaired and large and small canals dredged for sixty-five li; in all more than two hundred thirty-three thousand mu of fields in Nanzheng and Baocheng were irrigated.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification offices spent 31,000-odd strings; six barrages and sixty-five li of canals were repaired, irrigating 233,000-odd mu in Nanzheng and Baocheng.

sentences.zh: ”詔獎諭拱。

translations.literal: An edict praised and instructed Gong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Wu Gong.

sentences.zh: 八年，戶部侍郎兼樞密都承旨葉衡言：“奉詔核實寧國府、太平州圩岸，內寧國府惠民、化城舊圩四十餘里，新築九里餘；

translations.literal: In year 8 Vice Minister of Revenue and Bureau of Military Affairs director Ye Heng said: "Receiving an edict to verify polder embankments in Ningguo Prefecture and Taiping Prefecture—within Ningguo the Huimin and Huacheng old polders of more than forty li, newly built more than nine li;
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Vice Minister Ye Heng reported verification of polders in Ningguo and Taiping: Ningguo's Huimin and Huacheng old polders exceeded forty li, with nine-odd li newly built;

sentences.zh: 太平州黃池鎮福定圩周四十餘里，庭福等五十四圩周一百五十餘里，包圍諸圩在內，蕪湖縣圩周二百九十餘里，通當塗圩共四百八十餘里。

translations.literal: Taiping Prefecture Huangchi Town Fuding polder forty-odd li in circumference, Tingfu and fifty-four other polders one hundred fifty-odd li, wrapping inner polders within; Wuhu County polder two hundred ninety-odd li, together with Dangtu polder four hundred eighty-odd li in all.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping's Fuding polder at Huangchi, fifty-four polders including Tingfu, and Wuhu and Dangtu polders totaling 480-odd li.

sentences.zh: 並高廣堅致，瀕水一岸種植榆柳，足捍風濤，詢之農民，實為永利。

translations.literal: All are high, broad, and solid; along the water's edge one bank plants elm and willow, sufficient to ward off wind and waves; inquiring of farmers, it is truly lasting benefit.
translations.idiomatic: All were high, broad, and solid, with elms and willows along the water to break wind and waves; farmers confirmed lasting benefit.

sentences.zh: ”於是詔獎諭判寧國府魏王愷，略曰：“大江之堧，其地廣袤，使水之蓄泄不病而皆為膏腴者，圩之為利也。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon an edict praised Ningguo prefectural overseer Prince Wei Wang Kai, briefly saying: "Along the Yangzi's banks the land is broad; where water's storage and discharge are not harmed and all become fertile soil, the benefit of polders is at work.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Wei Wang Kai, overseer of Ningguo, was praised: "Along the great river, polders turn floodlands into fertile fields when water is properly stored and released.

sentences.zh: 然水土鬥齧，從昔善壞。

translations.literal: Yet water and earth contend and erode; from old they are apt to break.
translations.idiomatic: Yet water and earth always contend, and works decay.

sentences.zh: 卿聿修稼政，巨防屹然，有懷勤止，深用歎嘉。

translations.literal: You have attended to farming policy; great dikes stand firm; your diligent care moves Us to deep praise and sighing admiration.
translations.idiomatic: You have tended farming policy well; great dikes stand firm; your diligence wins Our deep praise."

sentences.zh: ”九年八月，臣僚言江西連年荒旱，不能預興水利為之備。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of year 9 officials said Jiangxi has for successive years been waste and drought, unable beforehand to promote waterworks as preparation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 9 officials said Jiangxi had suffered drought for years without preparing waterworks.

sentences.zh: 於是乃降詔曰：“朕惟旱幹、水溢之災，堯、湯盛時，有不能免。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict was issued saying: "We consider that drought and flood calamities—even in the flourishing times of Yao and Tang could not be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: "Drought and flood afflicted even Yao and Tang at their height.

sentences.zh: 民未告病者，備先具也。

translations.literal: Where the people have not reported affliction, preparations are already in place.
translations.idiomatic: Where the people do not suffer, preparations are already made.

sentences.zh: 豫章諸郡縣，但阡陌近水者，苗秀而實；

translations.literal: In the various commanderies of Yuzhang, only fields near water on the paths have seedlings lush and grain solid;
translations.idiomatic: In Yuzhang, only fields near water bear full grain;

sentences.zh: 高卬之地，雨不時至，苗輒就槁。

translations.literal: on high uplands, when rain does not come in season, seedlings promptly wither.
translations.idiomatic: on high ground, untimely rain withers the crop.

sentences.zh: 意水利不修，失所以為旱備乎？

translations.literal: Does this mean waterworks are not repaired and the means to prepare for drought are lost?
translations.idiomatic: Is this because waterworks lie neglected and drought preparation is lacking?"

sentences.zh: 唐韋丹為江西觀察使，治陂塘五百九十八所，灌田萬二千頃。

translations.literal: In Tang, Wei Dan as Jiangxi observation commissioner governed five hundred ninety-eight ponds and barrages, irrigating twelve thousand qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang, Wei Dan as Jiangxi observation commissioner repaired 598 ponds and barrages, irrigating 12,000 qing.

sentences.zh: 此特施之一道，其利如此，矧天下至廣也。

translations.literal: This was applied in one circuit only, yet its benefit was such—how much more the realm's utmost breadth.
translations.idiomatic: That was one circuit alone; how much greater the realm.

sentences.zh: 農為生之本也，泉流灌溉，所以毓五穀也。

translations.literal: Agriculture is the root of life; springs and irrigation are what nurture the five grains.
translations.idiomatic: Agriculture is the root of life; irrigation nurtures the five grains.

sentences.zh: 今諸道名山，川原甚眾，民未知其利。

translations.literal: Now on famous mountains on all circuits the rivers and plains are very many, and the people do not yet know their benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Many rivers remain unused while the people do not know their benefit.

sentences.zh: 然則通溝瀆，瀦陂澤，監司、守令，顧非其職歟？

translations.literal: Then opening ditches and canals, storing ponds and marshes—is this not the duty of circuit supervisors and prefects?
translations.idiomatic: Opening canals and storing marshes—is this not the duty of intendants and prefects?"

sentences.zh: 其為朕相丘陵原隰之宜，勉農桑，盡地利，平繇行水，勿使失時。

translations.literal: Let Us for the people survey what suits hills, mounds, plains, and lowlands; encourage mulberry and farming; exhaust the land's advantage; level corvée and conduct water—do not let seasons be missed.
translations.idiomatic: Let officials survey terrain, encourage farming, use the land fully, manage corvée and waterworks, and keep to the seasons.

sentences.zh: 雖有豐凶，而力田者不至拱手受弊，亦天人相因之理也。

translations.literal: Though there be abundance or scarcity, those who work the fields will not reach the point of folding hands and receiving harm—this too is the principle of Heaven and man responding to one another.
translations.idiomatic: Then even in lean years farmers need not sit idle in ruin—this is Heaven and man in harmony."

sentences.zh: 朕將即勤惰而寓賞罰焉。

translations.literal: We shall soon apply reward and punishment according to diligence and sloth.
translations.idiomatic: We shall soon reward diligence and punish neglect."

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年，兩浙轉運判官陳峴言：“昨奉詔遍走平江府、常州、江陰軍，諭民並力開浚利港諸處，並已畢功。

translations.literal: In Chunxi year 2 Two Zhe transport vice commissioner Chen Xian said: "Yesterday receiving an edict I went throughout Pingjiang Prefecture, Changzhou, and Jiangyin Army, instructing the people together to open and dredge Ligang and other places—all already completed.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 2 Two Zhe Transport Vice Commissioner Chen Xian reported: "Having toured Pingjiang, Changzhou, and Jiangyin to open Ligang and other works, all are complete.

sentences.zh: 始欲官給錢米，歲不下數萬，今皆百姓相率效力而成。

translations.literal: At first it was planned that the state supply cash and grain, each year not less than tens of thousands; now all was accomplished by the people leading one another to contribute labor.
translations.idiomatic: The state had planned tens of thousands in cash and grain yearly; instead the people rallied and finished the work themselves.

sentences.zh: ”詔常熟知縣劉穎特增一秩，餘論賞有差。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict specially advanced Changshu magistrate Liu Ying one rank step; the rest were discussed for reward with differences.
translations.idiomatic: Changshu Magistrate Liu Ying was specially advanced one rank; others received rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 三年，賜皇子判明州魏王愷詔曰：“陂湖川澤之利，或通或塞，存乎其人。

translations.literal: In year 3 an edict granted to the imperial prince overseeing Mingzhou, Prince Wei Wang Kai, said: "The benefit of ponds, lakes, streams, and marshes—whether open or blocked—depends on the person.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 an edict to Prince Wei Wang Kai, imperial prince overseeing Mingzhou, read: "The benefit of ponds, lakes, streams, and marshes—whether they flow freely or lie choked—depends on those who tend them.

sentences.zh: 四明為州實治鄞，鄞之鄉東西凡十四，而錢湖之水實溉其東之七。

translations.literal: Siming as a prefecture in fact governs Yin; Yin's townships east and west number fourteen in all, and Qian Lake's waters in fact irrigate seven of those to the east.
translations.idiomatic: Siming Prefecture is in fact administered from Yin; Yin has fourteen townships east and west, and the waters of Qian Lake irrigate seven of those to the east.

sentences.zh: 吏惰不虔，葑蕪翳，利失其舊，農人病焉。

translations.literal: Officials were lazy and not reverent; duckweed and weeds overgrew and shaded it; the benefit lost its former state, and farmers suffered from it.
translations.idiomatic: Officials grew negligent; duckweed and weeds choked the lake; its benefit dwindled from what it had been, and farmers suffered.

sentences.zh: 卿臨是邦，乃能講求利便而浚治之，遂使並湖七鄉之田，無異時旱幹之患，其為澤豈淺哉。

translations.literal: You preside over this state and were able to seek out advantages and dredge and govern it; thus you made the fields of the seven townships along the lake free from the drought calamity of other times—how shallow is the benefit you have bestowed!
translations.idiomatic: You govern this prefecture and have sought out what was advantageous and dredged the lake, so that the fields of the seven lakeside townships no longer suffer drought as in former times. The blessing you have conferred is no small one.

sentences.zh: 剡奏徹聞，不忘嘉歎。

translations.literal: Your carved memorial has reached Our hearing; We do not forget to praise and sigh in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Your memorial has reached Us, and Our praise and admiration remain with you.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 十年，大理寺丞張抑言：“陂澤湖塘，水則資之瀦泄，旱則資之灌溉。

translations.literal: In year 10 Dali Temple vice director Zhang Yi said: "Ponds, marshes, lakes, and pools—in flood they supply storage and drainage, in drought they supply irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 Dali Temple Vice Director Zhang Yi said: "Ponds, marshes, lakes, and pools serve to store and release water in flood and to irrigate in drought.

sentences.zh: 近者浙西豪宗，每遇旱歲，占湖為田，築為長堤，中植榆柳，外捍茭蘆，於是舊為田者，始隔水之出入。

translations.literal: Recently in western Zhe powerful clans, whenever drought years come, seize lakes as fields, build them into long dikes, plant elm and willow within, and ward off rushes and reeds without—thus fields that were formerly fields now first block water's coming and going.
translations.idiomatic: Recently powerful clans in western Zhe, whenever drought comes, seize lakes for fields, build long dikes planted with elm and willow within and rushes and reeds without, so that fields that were once fields now block the movement of water altogether.

sentences.zh: 蘇、湖、常、秀昔有水患，今多旱災，蓋出於此。

translations.literal: Su, Hu, Chang, and Xiu formerly had water calamities; now they mostly have drought disasters—this largely arises from this.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou, Huzhou, Changzhou, and Xiuzhou once suffered from flood; now they suffer chiefly from drought—and the cause lies here.

sentences.zh: 乞責縣令毋給據，尉警捕，監司覺察。

translations.literal: I beg to charge magistrates not to issue certificates, assistant magistrates to warn and arrest, and circuit supervisors to detect.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that magistrates be forbidden to issue land certificates, assistant magistrates charged to warn and arrest offenders, and circuit intendants to investigate.

sentences.zh: 有圍裹者，以違製論；

translations.literal: Whoever encircles and wraps fields shall be judged under violation of regulations;
translations.idiomatic: whoever encircles land for reclamation shall be prosecuted for violating regulations;

sentences.zh: 給據與失察者，並坐之。

translations.literal: those who issue certificates and those who fail in oversight shall both be punished together.
translations.idiomatic: and those who issue certificates or fail in oversight shall be punished as well.

sentences.zh: ”既而漕臣錢衝之請每圍立石以識之，共一千四百八十九所，令諸郡遵守焉。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Soon after transport commissioner Qian Chongzhi asked that each encircled field have a stone erected to mark it—1,489 places in all—and ordered all prefectures to observe this.
translations.idiomatic: Transport Commissioner Qian Chongzhi then petitioned that a marker stone be set up at each encircled field—1,489 sites in all—and ordered every prefecture to enforce the rule.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年，詔守令到任半年後，具水源湮塞合開修處以聞；

translations.literal: In Shaoxi year 2 an edict ordered that half a year after prefects and magistrates take office they itemize places where water sources are choked and blocked that should be opened and repaired and report;
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxi 2 an edict required that six months after taking office prefects and magistrates report all choked water sources that should be opened or repaired;

sentences.zh: 任滿日，以興修水利圖進，擇其勞效著明者賞之。

translations.literal: on the day their term ends, advance a chart of waterworks repair, and select those whose labor and effect are outstanding for reward.
translations.idiomatic: and on completing their terms submit maps of waterworks undertaken, with rewards for those whose achievements were outstanding.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年，戶部尚書袁說友等言：“浙西圍田相望，皆千百畝，陂塘漊瀆，悉為田疇，有水則無地可瀦，有旱則無水可戽。

translations.literal: In Qingyuan year 2 Ministry of Revenue minister Yuan Shuoyou and others said: "In western Zhe encircled fields stretch in sight of one another, each a thousand or a hundred mu; ponds and shallow canals are all turned to fields—when there is water there is no place to store it, when there is drought there is no water to bail.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingyuan 2 Minister of Revenue Yuan Shuoyou and others said: "In western Zhe encircled fields stretch from horizon to horizon, each hundreds or thousands of mu; ponds and canals have all been turned to farmland—when rain comes there is nowhere to store it, and in drought there is no water to draw.

sentences.zh: 不嚴禁之，後將益甚，無復稔歲矣。

translations.literal: If not strictly forbidden, afterward it will grow worse still, and there will be no more abundant harvest years.
translations.idiomatic: Unless this is strictly forbidden, the damage will only worsen and good harvest years will cease.

sentences.zh: ”嘉泰元年，以大理司直留佑賢、宗正寺主簿李澄措置，自淳熙十一年立石之後，凡官民圍裹者盡開之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. In Jiatai year 1 Dali bureau direct clerk Liu Youxian and Director of the Imperial Clan Court registrar Li Cheng were assigned to arrange matters; since Chunxi year 11 when marker stones were erected, all encircled fields by officials and commoners were fully opened.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiatai 1 Dali Bureau Direct Clerk Liu Youxian and Imperial Clan Court Registrar Li Cheng were assigned to take charge; since the marker stones were set up in Chunxi 11, every encircled field, official or private, was broken open.

sentences.zh: 又令知縣並以“點檢圍田事”入銜，每歲三四月，同尉點檢有無奸民圍裹狀，上於州，州聞於朝。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that magistrates all add to their titles "Inspector of Encircled Field Affairs"; each year in the third and fourth months, together with assistant magistrates inspect whether there are reports of wicked commoners encircling fields, report upward to the prefecture, and the prefecture report to court.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates were also required to add "Inspector of Encircled Field Affairs" to their titles; each year in the third and fourth months they were to join assistant magistrates in inspecting for illegal encirclements and report to the prefecture, which reported to court.

sentences.zh: 三年遣官審視，及委台諫察之。

translations.literal: Every three years officials are dispatched to review on site, and censor-remonstrators are entrusted to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years officials were dispatched to review the work, and censor-remonstrators were charged with oversight.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，佑賢、澄使還，奏追毀臨安、平江、嘉興，湖、常開掘戶元給佃據。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 2 Youxian and Cheng returned from their mission and memorialized to pursue and destroy the original tenancy certificates given to those who opened and dug in Lin'an, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Hu, and Chang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 2 Youxian and Cheng returned and memorialized for the cancellation of original tenancy certificates issued to those who had opened encircled fields in Lin'an, Pingjiang, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，右正言施康年言：“近屬貴戚不體九重愛民之心，止為一家營私之計，公然投牒以沮成法，乞戒飭：自今有陳狀者，指名奏劾，必罰無赦。

translations.literal: In the third month Right Remonstrance Shi Kangnian said: "Recently related great kin do not embody the Ninefold Height's heart of loving the people, but stop at one family's scheme for private gain, openly submitting petitions to obstruct established law. I beg a warning: from now on whoever submits a petition—name them in memorial impeachment; punishment without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Right Remonstrance Shi Kangnian said: "Recently imperial kinsmen have shown no regard for the throne's care for the people, pursuing private gain for their households alone and openly filing petitions to obstruct established law. I beg that a warning be issued: from this day forward, whoever petitions on such matters shall be impeached by name and punished without mercy.

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark.
translations.idiomatic: Closing quotation mark.

sentences.zh: 開禧二年，以淮農流移，無田可耕，詔兩浙州縣已開圍田，許元主復圍，專召淮農租種。

translations.literal: In Kaixi year 2, because Huai farmers drifted and migrated with no fields to cultivate, an edict ordered that in Two Zhe prefectures and counties where encircled fields had been opened, the original owners might re-encircle them and specially summon Huai farmers to rent and plant.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaixi 2, because displaced farmers from the Huai region had no land to cultivate, an edict allowed Two Zhe prefectures and counties to let original owners re-encircle fields that had been opened and to lease them exclusively to Huai refugees for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 嘉定三年，臣僚言：“竊聞豪民巨室並緣為奸，加倍圍裹，又影射包占水蕩，有妨農民灌溉。

translations.literal: In Jiading year 3 officials memorialized: "We have heard that powerful households and great estates take advantage together to commit wrongdoing, doubling their polder enclosures, and also covertly seizing and occupying water flats, to the detriment of farmers' irrigation."
translations.idiomatic: In Jiading 3 officials reported: "We hear that wealthy clans and great estates collude in fraud, double their polder reclamations, and covertly seize water flats, obstructing irrigation for common farmers."

sentences.zh: ”於是復詔浙西提舉司俟農隙開掘。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Thereupon an edict again ordered the Western Zhe intendant office to wait for a slack season in farming and open and dredge.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered the Western Zhe intendant office to wait until the agricultural off-season and reopen the encircled fields.

sentences.zh: 七年，復臨安府西湖舊界，盡蠲歲增租錢。

translations.literal: In year 7 the old boundaries of West Lake in Lin'an Prefecture were restored, and all annually increased rent money was fully remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Lin'an Prefecture's West Lake was restored to its former bounds, and all added annual rent was remitted in full.

sentences.zh: 十七年，臣僚言：“越之鑒湖，溉田幾半會稽，興化之木蘭陂，民田萬頃，歲飲其澤。

translations.literal: In year 17 officials memorialized: "Yue's Mirror Lake irrigates nearly half of Kuaiji; Xinghua's Mulan Barrage waters ten thousand qing of people's fields, and each year they drink its bounty."
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 officials said: "Mirror Lake in Yue irrigates nearly half of Kuaiji; Mulan Barrage in Xinghua waters ten thousand qing of farmland, and each year the people depend on its bounty."

sentences.zh: 今官豪侵占，填淤益狹。

translations.literal: Now officials and powerful families encroach and occupy; silt fills in and it grows ever narrower.
translations.idiomatic: Now officials and the powerful have encroached upon them; silt has filled them in and they grow ever narrower.

sentences.zh: 宜戒有司每歲省視，厚其瀦蓄，去其壅底，毋容侵占，以妨灌溉。

translations.literal: It is fitting to warn the responsible offices to inspect each year, deepen their storage, remove their choked bottoms, and not permit encroachment, so as not to obstruct irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: Responsible offices should be warned to inspect yearly, deepen storage, clear silt, forbid encroachment, and keep irrigation unimpeded.

sentences.zh: ”皆次第行之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. All were carried out in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted these measures in sequence.

sentences.zh: 寶慶元年，以右諫議大夫朱端常奏，除嘉泰間已開浙西圍田租錢，蓋稅額尚存，州縣迫民白納故也。

translations.literal: In Baoqing year 1, on the memorial of Right Remonstrance Grandee Zhu Duanchang, rent on Zhexi polder fields opened in the Jiatai era was abolished—for tax quotas still remained and prefectures and counties forced the people to pay in white cash.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoqing 1, on the memorial of Right Remonstrance Grandee Zhu Duanchang, rent on western Zhe polders opened in the Jiatai era was abolished, because tax quotas still stood and local officials forced the people to pay cash directly.

sentences.zh: 寶祐元年，史館校勘黃國麵對：“圍田自淳熙十一年識石者當存之，復圍者合權其利害輕重而為之存毀，其租或歸總所，或隸安邊所，或分隸諸郡。

translations.literal: In Baoyou year 1, Hanlin reviser Huang Guomian addressed the throne: "Polder fields marked by stones since Chunxi year 11 should be kept; those re-enclosed should be weighed for lighter or heavier harm and benefit in deciding whether to keep or destroy them; their rent may go to the General Office, or to the Border Pacification Office, or be divided among prefectures."
translations.idiomatic: In Baoyou 1, Hanlin Reviser Huang Guomian addressed the throne: "Polder fields marked with boundary stones since Chunxi 11 should be preserved; re-enclosures should be judged by their harm and benefit; rents may go to the General Office, the Border Pacification Office, or be divided among prefectures."

sentences.zh: ”上曰：“安邊所田，近已撥歸本所。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The emperor said: "Border Pacification Office fields have recently been reassigned to their original offices."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Fields of the Border Pacification Office have lately been returned to their original jurisdictions."

sentences.zh: ”國又奏：“自丁未已來創圍之田，始因殿司獻草蕩，任事者欲因以為功，凡旱幹處悉圍之，利少害多，宜開掘以通水道。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Guo again memorialized: "Since the dingwei year newly enclosed fields began when the Palace Service presented reed flats; those in charge wished to make it their achievement, and every drought-stricken place was enclosed—little benefit, much harm. They should be opened and dredged to clear the waterways."
translations.idiomatic: Guo memorialized further: "Since the dingwei year, new polders began when the Palace Service offered reed flats and officials sought merit; every drought-prone tract was enclosed—little gain, much harm. They should be broken open to restore waterways."

sentences.zh: ”上然之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 咸淳十年，以江東水傷，除九年圩田租，減四分。

translations.literal: In Xianchun year 10, because Jiangdong suffered flood damage, rent on year 9 polder fields was remitted, reduced by four-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianchun 10, because Jiangdong suffered flood damage, rent on year 9 polder fields was remitted by four-tenths.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十七年，趙子潚奉詔措置鎮江府沙田，欲輕立租課，令見佃者就耕；

translations.literal: In Shaoxing year 27 Zhao Zishe received an edict to arrange sand fields in Zhenjiang Prefecture, wishing to set rent lightly and let current tenants cultivate on the spot;
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 27 Zhao Zishe was ordered to arrange Zhenjiang sand fields, intending to set light rents and let current tenants farm on the spot;

sentences.zh: 如勢家占吝，追日前所收租利。

translations.literal: if powerful families hoarded and were stingy, pursue the rent and profit collected in prior days.
translations.idiomatic: if powerful families hoarded land, prior rents and profits were to be recovered.

sentences.zh: 詔速拘其田措置，蠲其冒佃之租。

translations.literal: An edict ordered their fields quickly seized and arranged, and fraudulent tenancy rent remitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered such fields seized and arranged at once, with fraudulent tenancy rent remitted.

sentences.zh: 二十八年正月，詔戶部員外郎莫濛同浙西、江東、淮南漕臣趙子潚、鄧根、孫藎視諸路沙田、蘆場。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 28 an edict ordered Ministry of Revenue vice director Mo Hong together with transport commissioners of western Zhe, Jiangdong, and Huainan—Zhao Zishe, Deng Gen, and Sun Jin—to inspect sand fields and reed flats on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 28 an edict ordered Ministry of Revenue Vice Director Mo Hong, together with western Zhe, Jiangdong, and Huainan transport commissioners Zhao Zishe, Deng Gen, and Sun Jin, to inspect sand fields and reed flats on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 先是，言者謂江、淮間沙田、蘆場為人冒占，歲失官課至多，故以命濛等。

translations.literal: Earlier, memorializers said that sand fields and reed flats between the Yangzi and Huai were fraudulently occupied by people, and each year official revenue lost was very great; therefore Hong and others were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier memorializers had said sand fields and reed flats along the Yangzi and Huai were widely fraudulently occupied, costing the state vast revenue yearly; hence Hong and others were appointed.

sentences.zh: 既而殿中侍御史葉義問言：“奉行者不恤百姓，名為經量，實逼縣官按圖約紐，惟務增數，以希進用。

translations.literal: Soon after Palace Attendant Censor Ye Yiwen said: "Those carrying out the edict do not pity the common people. It is called land survey, but in fact it forces county officials to bind figures to maps, striving only to increase numbers to hope for advancement."
translations.idiomatic: Soon after Palace Attendant Censor Ye Yiwen said: "Those executing the order spare no thought for the people. Called a land survey, it in truth forces county officials to bind figures to maps, seeking only higher numbers for promotion."

sentences.zh: 有力之家初無加損，貧民下戶已受其害。

translations.literal: Powerful households at first suffered no increase or decrease; poor commoners and lower households already received the harm.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful households were untouched at first; poor households and the lowest ranks already bore the harm.

sentences.zh: 因小利擾之，必致逃移，坐失稅額。

translations.literal: Disturbing them for small profit will surely cause flight and migration and result in lost tax quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Harassing them for petty gain will surely drive people to flee and tax quotas will be lost.

sentences.zh: ”因極論之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. He therefore argued it to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: He argued the point at length.

sentences.zh: 二月，詔：“沙田、蘆場止為勢家詭名冒占，其三等以下戶勿例根括。

translations.literal: In the second month an edict said: "Sand fields and reed flats are solely for powerful families' false names and fraudulent occupation; households of the third rank and below are not to be surveyed by precedent."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month an edict declared: "Sand fields and reed flats exist chiefly for powerful families' false claims; third-rank households and below are not to be surveyed by precedent."

sentences.zh: ”六月，以孫藎措置沙田滅裂，罷之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. In the sixth month, because Sun Jin's arrangement of sand fields was slipshod, he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Sun Jin was dismissed for slipshod handling of sand fields.

sentences.zh: 詔：“浙西江東沙田、蘆場，官戶十頃、民戶二十頃以上並增租，餘如舊。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Sand fields and reed flats in western Zhe and Jiangdong—official households of ten qing and common households of twenty qing and above all have rent increased; the rest remain as before."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "For sand fields and reed flats in western Zhe and Jiangdong, official households of ten qing and common households of twenty qing and above shall pay increased rent; the rest remain as before."

sentences.zh: 置提領官田所掌之，不隸戶部。

translations.literal: A Directorate for Overseeing Official Fields was established to manage them, subordinate not to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: A Directorate for Overseeing Official Fields was established to manage them, outside the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: ”二十九年，以莫濛經量沙田、蘆場失實，責監饒州景德鎮稅，遂詔盡罷所增租。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. In year 29, because Mo Hong's survey of sand fields and reed flats was untrue, he was demoted to supervise tax at Jingde Town in Raozhou; thereupon an edict fully abolished the increased rent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 Mo Hong was demoted to supervise Jingde Town tax in Raozhou for an untrue survey of sand fields and reed flats, and an edict abolished all increased rent.

sentences.zh: 三十二年九月，趙子潚言：“浙西、江東、淮東沙田，往年經量，有不盡不實處，為人戶包占。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of year 32 Zhao Zishe said: "Sand fields in western Zhe, Jiangdong, and Huaidong—in prior years' surveys there were places not fully or truly measured, occupied by households."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 32 Zhao Zishe said: "Sand fields in western Zhe, Jiangdong, and Huaidong—in prior surveys some tracts were not fully or accurately measured and remain occupied by households."

sentences.zh: 期以今冬自陳，給為己業，與免租稅之半；

translations.literal: They are given until this winter to report themselves, granted as their own property, and granted remission of half their rent and tax;
translations.idiomatic: They may report themselves by this winter, receive title as their own property, and have half their rent and tax remitted;

sentences.zh: 過期許人告，以全戶所租田賞之。

translations.literal: after the deadline others may report them, and the whole household's rented fields are rewarded to the informer.
translations.idiomatic: after the deadline informers may report them and receive the entire offending household's rented fields as reward.

sentences.zh: 其蘆場量力輕租。

translations.literal: Reed flats are to have light rent set according to capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Reed flats shall bear light rent according to their capacity.

sentences.zh: ”詔以馮方措置。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict ordered Feng Fang to arrange matters.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Feng Fang to take charge.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，方滋疏論沙田。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Fang Zi memorialized at length on sand fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Fang Zi submitted a lengthy memorial on sand fields.

sentences.zh: 上問：“沙田或以為可取，或以為可捐。

translations.literal: The emperor asked: "Sand fields—some hold they may be taken, some that they may be abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked: "Some say sand fields may be exploited; others that they should be abandoned."

sentences.zh: ”陳康伯等奏：“君子小人，各從其類。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Chen Kangbo and others memorialized: "The gentleman and the petty man each follow his kind."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kangbo and others memorialized: "Gentlemen and petty men each follow their kind."

sentences.zh: 小人樂於生事，不惜為國斂怨；

translations.literal: Petty men delight in creating affairs and do not spare drawing the state's resentment;
translations.idiomatic: Petty men delight in stirring up affairs and do not shrink from heaping resentment on the state;

sentences.zh: 君子務存大體，唯恐有傷仁政，所以不同。

translations.literal: gentlemen strive to preserve the larger pattern and only fear harming humane government—therefore they differ.
translations.idiomatic: gentlemen strive to preserve the larger design and fear harming humane government—hence they differ.

sentences.zh: ”上然之，命止前詔勿行。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The emperor approved and ordered the prior edict not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and ordered the prior edict withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，以大理寺主簿丁仲京言，凡學田為勢家侵佃者，命提學官覺察。

translations.literal: In year 21, on the statement of Dali Temple registrar Ding Zhongjing, wherever school fields were encroached upon and tenanted by powerful families, education officials were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21, on Dali Temple Registrar Ding Zhongjing's memorial, wherever school lands were encroached by powerful families, education officials were ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 又命撥僧寺常住絕產以贍學。

translations.literal: It was further ordered to allocate Buddhist monasteries' permanent estates with no heirs to support schools.
translations.idiomatic: Monasteries' permanent heirless estates were also ordered allocated to support schools.

sentences.zh: 戶部議並撥無敕額庵院田，詔可。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue deliberated and also allocated fields of hermitages and cloisters without imperial charter; the edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue proposed also allocating unchartered hermitage and cloister lands; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 初，閩以福建八郡之田分三等：膏腴者給僧寺、道院，中下者給土著流寓。

translations.literal: At first Fujian divided the fields of the eight Fujian prefectures into three grades: fertile tracts were given to Buddhist temples and Daoist abbeys; middle and lower went to natives and sojourners.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Fujian divided the eight prefectures' fields into three grades: fertile land went to temples and abbeys; middling and lower grades to natives and migrants.

sentences.zh: 自劉夔為福州，始貿易取貲。

translations.literal: From the time Liu Kui was in Fuzhou, trade for cash began.
translations.idiomatic: From Liu Kui's term as Fuzhou prefect, the fields began to be traded for cash.

sentences.zh: 迨張守帥閩，紹興二年秋。

translations.literal: When Zhang Shou commanded Fujian—autumn of Shaoxing year 2.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Shou took command in Fujian—in autumn of Shaoxing 2.

sentences.zh: 上倚以拊循凋瘵，存上等四十餘刹以待高僧，餘悉令民請買，歲入七、八萬緡以助軍衣，餘寬百姓雜科，民皆便之。

translations.literal: The emperor relied on him to soothe the wasted and afflicted; more than forty superior monasteries of the upper grade were kept for eminent monks; the rest were all ordered sold to the people by petition; annual intake of seventy or eighty thousand strings assisted military clothing, and the remainder eased miscellaneous levies on the people—the people all found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor relied on him to revive a devastated region; more than forty upper-grade monasteries were reserved for eminent monks; the rest were sold to the people, yielding seventy or eighty thousand strings yearly for military supplies while easing miscellaneous levies—the people welcomed it.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，以諸路賣官田錢七分上供，三分充常平司糴本。

translations.literal: In year 26, of money from selling official fields on all circuits, seven-tenths were sent up and three-tenths supplied the ever-normal office's grain-purchase capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26, proceeds from selling official fields on all circuits were split: seven-tenths submitted, three-tenths reserved for ever-normal grain purchases.

sentences.zh: 初，盡鬻官田，議者恐佃人失業，未賣者失租。

translations.literal: At first, when all official fields were to be sold, deliberators feared tenants would lose their livelihood and unsold fields would lose rent.
translations.idiomatic: When full sale of official fields was first proposed, critics feared tenants would lose livelihood and unsold tracts would lose rent.

sentences.zh: 侍御史葉義問言：“今盡鬻其田，立為正稅，田既歸民，稅又歸官，不獨絕欺隱之弊，又可均力役之法。

translations.literal: Attendant Censor Ye Yiwen said: "Now if all their fields are sold and established as regular tax, once fields return to the people and tax returns to the state, not only is the abuse of concealment ended, but corvée labor can also be equalized."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Censor Ye Yiwen said: "If all such fields are sold and regular tax established, land returns to the people and revenue to the state—concealment ends and corvée can be equalized."

sentences.zh: ”浙東刑獄使者邵大受亦乞承買官田者免物力三年至十年。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Eastern Zhe penal commissioner Shao Dashou also begged that purchasers of official fields be exempt from property levies for three to ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Zhe Penal Commissioner Shao Dashou also asked that purchasers of official fields be exempt from property levies for three to ten years.

sentences.zh: 一千貫以下免三年，一千貫以上五年，五千貫以上十年。

translations.literal: Below one thousand strings, three years; one thousand strings and above, five years; five thousand strings and above, ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Below 1,000 strings, three years; 1,000 strings and above, five years; 5,000 strings and above, ten years.

sentences.zh: 於是詔所在常平沒官、戶絕田，已佃未佃、已添租未添租，並拘賣。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered that wherever there were ever-normal confiscated official fields and heirless estates—tenanted or not, with added rent or without—all were to be seized and sold.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all ever-normal confiscated and heirless official fields—tenanted or not, with added rent or without—to be sold.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，初，兩浙轉運司官莊田四萬二千餘畝，歲收稻、麥等四萬八千餘斛；

translations.literal: In year 29, at first the Two Zhe transport office's official estate fields were more than forty-two thousand mu, annually receiving more than forty-eight thousand bushels of rice, wheat, and the like;
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 the Two Zhe transport office held more than 42,000 mu of official estate fields, yielding more than 48,000 bushels of rice and wheat yearly;

sentences.zh: 營田九十二萬六千餘畝，歲收稻、麥、雜豆等十六萬七千餘斛，充行在馬料及糴錢。

translations.literal: military colony fields were more than nine hundred twenty-six thousand mu, annually receiving more than one hundred sixty-seven thousand bushels of rice, wheat, mixed beans, and the like, supplying the capital's horse fodder and grain-purchase funds.
translations.idiomatic: military colony fields exceeded 926,000 mu, yielding more than 167,000 bushels yearly for the capital's horse fodder and grain purchases.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔令出賣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month an edict ordered them sold off.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict ordered their sale.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔諸路提舉常平官督察欺弊，申嚴賞罰。

translations.literal: In the seventh month an edict ordered ever-normal intendants on all circuits to investigate fraud and strictly apply rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month an edict ordered ever-normal intendants on all circuits to investigate fraud and enforce rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 分水令張升佐、宜興令陳<辶巳>以賣田稽違，各貶秩罷任。

translations.literal: Fenshui magistrate Zhang Shengzuo and Yixing magistrate Chen Qian, for delay and violation in selling fields, were each demoted in rank and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Fenshui Magistrate Zhang Shengzuo and Yixing Magistrate Chen Qian were demoted and dismissed for irregularities in the land sale.

sentences.zh: 九月，浙東提舉常平都絜以賣田最多，增一秩。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Eastern Zhe ever-normal intendant Du Jie, for selling the most fields, was advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Eastern Zhe Ever-normal Intendant Du Jie was advanced one rank for selling the most fields.

sentences.zh: 三十年，詔承買荒田者免三年租。

translations.literal: In year 30 an edict ordered that purchasers of waste fields be exempt from three years' rent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 purchasers of waste land were granted three years' rent exemption.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年，戶部侍郎曾懷言：“江西路營田四千餘頃，已佃一千九百餘頃，租錢五萬五百餘貫，若出賣，可得六萬七千餘貫；

translations.literal: In Qiandao year 2 Vice Minister of Revenue Zeng Huai said: "Jiangxi Circuit military colony fields are more than four thousand qing; already tenanted are more than one thousand nine hundred qing; rent money is more than fifty thousand five hundred strings—if sold off, one could obtain more than sixty-seven thousand strings;
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 2 Vice Minister of Revenue Zeng Huai said: "Jiangxi military colony fields exceed 4,000 qing; 1,900-odd qing are tenanted, yielding 50,500-odd strings in rent—sale could bring 67,000-odd strings;

sentences.zh: 及兩浙轉運司所括已佃九十餘萬畝，合而言之，為數浩瀚。

translations.literal: and the Two Zhe transport office's tallied tenanted fields exceed nine hundred thousand mu; taken together the figure is vast.
translations.idiomatic: together with more than 900,000 mu of tenanted fields tallied by the Two Zhe transport office—the total is vast."

sentences.zh: 今欲遵元詔，見佃願買者減價二分。

translations.literal: Now we wish to follow the original edict: where current tenants wish to buy, reduce the price by two-tenths."
translations.idiomatic: We propose following the original edict: current tenants who wish to buy receive a twenty-percent reduction."

sentences.zh: ”詔曾懷等提領出賣，其錢輸左藏南庫別貯之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. An edict ordered Zeng Huai and others to oversee the sale; the money was paid into a separate store in the Left Treasury South Vault.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed Zeng Huai and others in charge of the sale; proceeds were deposited in a separate vault of the Left Treasury.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，江東路營田亦令見佃者減價承買，期以三月賣絕，八月住賣；

translations.literal: In the fourth month of year 4 Jiangdong military colony fields were also ordered sold to current tenants at reduced price, with a deadline of three months to complete sale and sale to cease in the eighth month;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 4 Jiangdong military colony fields were likewise offered to current tenants at reduced price, with three months to complete sales and sales ending in the eighth month;

sentences.zh: 諸路未賣營田，轉運司收租。

translations.literal: on all circuits military colony fields not sold were to have rent collected by the transport office.
translations.idiomatic: unsold military colony fields on all circuits were to remain under transport office rent collection.

sentences.zh: 七年，提舉浙西常平李結乞以見管營田撥歸本司，同常平田立管莊。

translations.literal: In year 7 Western Zhe ever-normal intendant Li Jie begged to transfer managed military colony fields back to his office and administer them jointly with ever-normal fields in official estate manors.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Western Zhe Ever-normal Intendant Li Jie asked to transfer military colony fields under his office and manage them with ever-normal lands in official manors.

sentences.zh: 梁克家亦奏：“戶部賣營田，率為有力者下價取之，稅入甚微，不如置官莊，歲可得五十萬斛。

translations.literal: Liang Kejia also memorialized: "When the Ministry of Revenue sells military colony fields, powerful households invariably take them at low price; tax intake is very slight. Better to establish official manors and annually obtain five hundred thousand bushels."
translations.idiomatic: Liang Kejia memorialized: "Ministry sales of military colony fields go chiefly to the powerful at low prices, with meager revenue. Official manors would yield five hundred thousand bushels yearly."

sentences.zh: ”八年，以大理寺主簿薛季宣於黃岡、麻城立官莊二十二所。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. In year 8 Dali Temple registrar Xue Jixuan established twenty-two official manors at Huanggang and Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Dali Temple Registrar Xue Jixuan established twenty-two official manors at Huanggang and Macheng.

sentences.zh: 九年，以司農寺丞葉翥等出賣浙東、西路諸官田，以登聞檢院張孝賁等出賣江東、西路諸官田，以郎官薛元鼎拘催江、浙、閩、廣賣官田錢四百餘萬緡。

translations.literal: In year 9 Director of Agriculture Ye Yu and others sold official fields in eastern and western Zhe; Court of Imperial Supplications reviewer Zhang Xiaoben and others sold official fields in Jiangdong and Jiangxi; a bureau director Xue Yuanding pressed collection of more than four million strings from selling official fields in Jiangsu, Zhe, Fujian, and Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Agriculture Director Ye Yu sold official fields in eastern and western Zhe; Imperial Supplications Reviewer Zhang Xiaoben sold Jiangdong and Jiangxi official fields; Bureau Director Xue Yuanding collected more than four million strings from official land sales in Jiangsu, Zhe, Fujian, and Guang.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，臣僚言：“出賣官田，二年之間，三省、戶部困於文移，監司、州郡疲於出賣。

translations.literal: In Chunxi year 1 officials memorialized: "In selling official fields, within two years the Three Departments and Ministry of Revenue were worn down by documents, circuit supervisors and prefectures and counties exhausted by selling."
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 1 officials said: "Selling official fields for two years has overwhelmed the Three Departments and Ministry of Revenue with paperwork and exhausted circuit and local officials."

sentences.zh: 上下督責，不為不至，始限一季，繼限一年，已賣者才十三，已輸者才十二。

translations.literal: Supervision from above and below was not lacking in effort: first a limit of one season, then a limit of one year—yet those sold were only thirteen parts, those paid in only twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Supervision was relentless: first one season, then one year—yet only thirteen parts were sold and only twelve paid in.

sentences.zh: 蓋賣產之家，無非大姓。

translations.literal: For households selling property were none but great surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Those buying were invariably great clans.

sentences.zh: 估價之初，以上色之產，輕立價貫，揭榜之後，率先投狀；

translations.literal: At the start of valuation, for top-grade property they lightly set the price in strings; after the notice was posted they were first to submit petitions;
translations.idiomatic: At valuation, top-grade plots were priced low; after posting, great clans bid first;

sentences.zh: 若中下之產，無人屬意，所立之價，輕重不均。

translations.literal: if middle or lower property, no one paid attention; the prices set were uneven in weight.
translations.idiomatic: middling and lower plots drew no bidders, and prices were wildly uneven.

sentences.zh: 莫若且令元佃之家著業輸租，數猶可得數十萬斛。

translations.literal: Better for now to order original tenant households to settle on the land and pay rent—the amount could still obtain several hundred thousand bushels."
translations.idiomatic: Better to let original tenants farm and pay rent—yielding several hundred thousand bushels still."

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. The court followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔諸路轉運、常平司，凡沒官田、營田、沙田、沙蕩之類，復括數賣之。

translations.literal: In year 6 an edict ordered transport and ever-normal offices on all circuits: all confiscated official fields, military colony fields, sand fields, sand flats, and the like were again to be tallied and sold.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 an edict ordered all circuits' transport and ever-normal offices to tally and sell confiscated official fields, military colonies, sand fields, and sand flats.

sentences.zh: 紹熙四年，以臣僚言住賣。

translations.literal: In Shaoxi year 4, on officials' memorial, sales were halted.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxi 4 sales were halted on officials' memorial.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年八月，江東轉運提舉司以紹熙四年住賣以後續沒官田，依鄉價復召人承買，以其錢充常平糴本。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of Qingyuan year 1 the Jiangdong transport and ever-normal office, for confiscated official fields accruing after Shaoxi year 4 when sales halted, again summoned purchasers at village price, using the money as ever-normal grain-purchase capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Qingyuan 1 Jiangdong transport and ever-normal offices, for confiscated fields accruing after Shaoxi 4, again sold at village prices for ever-normal grain funds.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，餘端禮、鄭僑言，福建地狹人稠，無以贍養，生子多不舉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Yu Duanli and Zheng Qiao said: "Fujian's land is narrow and its people dense; there is no means to support them, and many do not rear their children."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Yu Duanli and Zheng Qiao said: "Fujian is crowded on little land; families cannot support themselves and many abandon infants."

sentences.zh: 福建提舉宋之瑞乞免鬻建、劍、汀、邵沒官田，收其租助民舉子之費，詔從之。

translations.literal: Fujian intendant Song Zhirui begged to exempt sale of confiscated fields in Jian, Jianning, Ting, and Shaowu, collecting their rent to aid the people's costs of raising sons; the edict followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Intendant Song Zhirui asked to halt sale of confiscated fields in Jian, Jianning, Ting, and Shaowu and use their rent to aid child-rearing; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔諸路召賣不行田，復實減價，其沙礫不可新處除之。

translations.literal: In year 4 an edict ordered all circuits: for fields that would not sell at summoned sale, reduce prices in reality; places of sand and gravel that could not be newly worked were excluded.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 an edict ordered circuits to cut prices on unsold summoned-sale fields and exclude barren sand and gravel tracts.

sentences.zh: 開熙三年，韓侂胄既誅，金人講解。

translations.literal: In Kaixi year 3, after Han Tuozhou was executed, the Jin people negotiated peace.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaixi 3, after Han Tuozhou was executed, the Jin negotiated peace.

sentences.zh: 明年，用廷臣言，置安邊所，凡侂胄與其他權幸沒入之田，及圍田、湖田之在官者皆隸焉。

translations.literal: The next year, on court ministers' advice, the Border Pacification Office was established; all fields confiscated from Tuozhou and other favored powers, and polder and lake fields held by the state, were placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, on court advice, the Border Pacification Office was established; confiscated lands of Tuozhou and other favorites, and state polder and lake fields, were placed under it.

sentences.zh: 輸米七十二萬二千七百斛有奇，錢一百三十一萬五千緡有奇，藉以給行人金、繒之費。

translations.literal: It delivered more than seven hundred twenty-two thousand seven hundred bushels of rice, odd, and more than one million three hundred fifteen thousand strings, odd, by which to supply travelers' gold and silk expenses.
translations.idiomatic: It yielded 722,700-odd bushels of rice and 1,315,000-odd strings, supplying envoys' gold and silk expenses.

sentences.zh: 迨與北方絕好，軍需邊用每於此取之。

translations.literal: When relations with the north were severed, military needs and border expenses were regularly drawn from this.
translations.idiomatic: When relations with the north broke off, border and military expenses were regularly drawn from it.

sentences.zh: 景定四年，殿中侍御史陳堯道、右正言曹孝慶、監察御史虞慮張晞顏等言廩兵、和糴、造楮之弊，“乞依祖宗限田議，自兩浙、江東西官民戶逾限之田，抽三分之一買充公田。

translations.literal: In Jingding year 4 Palace Attendant Censor Chen Yaodao, Right Remonstrance Cao Xiaoqing, and Supervising Censor Yu Chunxi and Zhang Xiyan spoke of the abuses of granary soldiers, harmonized grain purchases, and paper-money issue: "We beg to follow the ancestral limit-field proposal—from official and common households in western Zhe and Jiangdong whose fields exceed the limit, buy one-third for public fields."
translations.idiomatic: In Jingding 4 Palace Attendant Censor Chen Yaodao, Right Remonstrance Cao Xiaoqing, and Supervising Censors Yu Chunxi and Zhang Xiyan denounced abuses in granary troops, harmonized purchases, and note issue: "We ask to follow the ancestral limit-field plan—buy one-third of excess holdings in western Zhe and Jiangdong for public fields."

sentences.zh: 得一千萬畝之田，則歲有六七百萬斛之入可以餉軍，可以免糴，可以重楮，可以平物而安富，一舉而五利具矣。

translations.literal: Obtaining ten million mu of fields, then each year six or seven million bushels of intake could feed the army, exempt harmonized purchase, strengthen paper notes, level prices and secure wealth—one act and five benefits are complete."
translations.idiomatic: Ten million mu would yield six or seven million bushels yearly to feed troops, end harmonized purchases, strengthen notes, stabilize prices, and secure prosperity—five gains at once."

sentences.zh: ”有旨從其言。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. There was an imperial order to follow their words.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 朝士有異議者，丞相賈似道奏：“救楮之策莫切於住造楮，住造楮莫切於免和糴，免和糴莫切於買逾限田。

translations.literal: Court gentlemen who differed—Chancellor Jia Sidao memorialized: "Of policies to save paper notes, none is more urgent than halting note issue; of halting note issue, none is more urgent than exempting harmonized purchase; of exempting harmonized purchase, none is more urgent than buying over-limit fields."
translations.idiomatic: Dissenting officials were answered by Chancellor Jia Sidao: "To save paper notes, halt new issue; to halt issue, end harmonized purchase; to end harmonized purchase, buy over-limit fields."

sentences.zh: ”因曆詆異議者之非，帝曰：“當一意行之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. He therefore denounced at length the wrong of the dissenters. The emperor said: "It must be carried out with single intent."
translations.idiomatic: He denounced dissenters at length. The emperor said: "Execute it resolutely."

sentences.zh: ”浙西安撫魏克愚言：“取四路民田立限回買，所以免和糴而益邦儲，議者非不自以為公且忠也。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. Western Zhe pacification commissioner Wei Keyu said: "Taking the people's fields of the four circuits within limits for buyback is to exempt harmonized purchase and increase state stores; the deliberators did not fail to think themselves public-spirited and loyal."
translations.idiomatic: Western Zhe Pacification Commissioner Wei Keyu said: "Buying back excess fields in four circuits to end harmonized purchase and fill state granaries seemed to dissenters a loyal public service."

sentences.zh: 然而未見其利，而適見其害。

translations.literal: Yet the benefit is not seen, while the harm is plainly seen.
translations.idiomatic: Yet benefit is nowhere seen while harm is plain.

sentences.zh: 近給事中徐經孫奏記丞相，言江西買田之弊甚詳，若浙西之弊，則尤有甚於經孫所言者。

translations.literal: Recently Attendant Gentleman Xu Jingsun memorialized to the chancellor, speaking in detail of the abuses of buying fields in Jiangxi; if the abuses in western Zhe, they are especially greater than what Jingsun stated."
translations.idiomatic: Recently Attendant Gentleman Xu Jingsun wrote the chancellor detailing abuses in Jiangxi; western Zhe's abuses exceed his account."

sentences.zh: ”因曆述其為害者八事，疏奏不省。

translations.literal: Closing quotation mark. He therefore set forth in sequence eight matters of harm; the memorial was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: He listed eight harms in sequence; the memorial went unheeded.

sentences.zh: 六郡回買公田，畝起租滿石者償二百貫，九鬥者償一百八十貫，八鬥者償一百六十貫，七鬥者償一百四十貫，六鬥者償一百二十貫。

translations.literal: In the six prefectures' buyback of public fields, for each mu whose assessed rent reached a full shi, two hundred strings were paid; nine dou, one hundred eighty strings; eight dou, one hundred sixty strings; seven dou, one hundred forty strings; six dou, one hundred twenty strings.
translations.idiomatic: In six prefectures' public-field buyback, rent of a full shi per mu paid 200 strings; nine dou, 180; eight dou, 160; seven dou, 140; six dou, 120.

sentences.zh: 五千畝以上，以銀半分、官告五分、度牒三分、會子二分半；

translations.literal: For five thousand mu and above: half in silver, five-tenths in office patents, three-tenths in ordination certificates, two and a half-tenths in treasury notes;
translations.idiomatic: For 5,000 mu and above: half silver, five-tenths office patents, three-tenths ordination certificates, two and a half-tenths treasury notes;

sentences.zh: 五千畝以下，以銀半分、官告三分、度牒二分、會子三分半；

translations.literal: below five thousand mu: half in silver, three-tenths in office patents, two-tenths in ordination certificates, three and a half-tenths in treasury notes;
translations.idiomatic: below 5,000 mu: half silver, three-tenths patents, two-tenths certificates, three and a half-tenths notes;

sentences.zh: 千畝以下，度牒、會子各半；

translations.literal: below one thousand mu, ordination certificates and treasury notes half each;
translations.idiomatic: below 1,000 mu, certificates and notes half each;

sentences.zh: 五百畝至三百畝，全以會子。

translations.literal: from five hundred mu to three hundred mu, entirely treasury notes.
translations.idiomatic: from 500 mu to 300 mu, notes only.

sentences.zh: 是歲，田事成，每石官給止四十貫，而半是告、牒，民持之而不得售，六郡騷然。

translations.literal: That year the field work was completed; for each shi the state paid only forty strings, and half were patents and certificates—the people held them and could not sell them; the six prefectures were in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: That year the buyback was completed; payment was forty strings per shi, half in patents and certificates that people could not sell; all six prefectures were in uproar.

sentences.zh: 所遣劉良貴、陳時、趙與時、廖邦傑、成公策等推賞有差。

translations.literal: Those dispatched—Liu Lianggui, Chen Shi, Zhao Yushi, Liao Bangjie, Cheng Gongce, and others—received differentiated promotions and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys Liu Lianggui, Chen Shi, Zhao Yushi, Liao Bangjie, Cheng Gongce, and others were promoted and rewarded in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 邦傑之在常州，害民特甚，民至有本無田而以歸並抑買自經者。

translations.literal: When Bangjie was in Changzhou he harmed the people especially severely; there were even commoners who originally had no fields yet, because of consolidation and compulsory purchase, hanged themselves.
translations.idiomatic: While Liao Bangjie held office in Changzhou he oppressed the people with particular severity. Some who had owned no land at all were driven by forced consolidation and purchase to take their own lives.

sentences.zh: 分置莊官催租，州縣督莊官及時交收運發。

translations.literal: Estate managers were appointed separately to press for rent; prefectures and counties supervised the estate managers to hand in collections on time and forward them.
translations.idiomatic: Separate estate managers were installed to collect rents, and prefectures and counties were ordered to see that those managers turned in and forwarded the revenue promptly.

sentences.zh: 五年，選官充官田所分司，平江、嘉興，安吉各一員，常州、江陰、鎮江共一員，凡公田事悉以委之。

translations.literal: In year 5 officials were selected as branch supervisors of the public-field office: one each for Pingjiang, Jiaxing, and Anji; Changzhou, Jiangyin, and Zhenjiang shared one; all public-field affairs were entrusted to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year officials were chosen as branch supervisors of the public-field office: one for Pingjiang, one for Jiaxing, one for Anji, and one shared by Changzhou, Jiangyin, and Zhenjiang. All matters concerning public fields were placed in their charge.

sentences.zh: 是歲七月，彗見於東方。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year a comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year a comet appeared in the eastern sky.

sentences.zh: 下詔求言，京學生蕭規、葉李等三學六館皆上封章；

translations.literal: An edict sought advice; capital students Xiao Gui, Ye Li, and others from the three academies and six halls all submitted sealed memorials;
translations.idiomatic: The court issued an edict calling for counsel, and capital students such as Xiao Gui and Ye Li from the three academies and six halls all submitted sealed memorials;

sentences.zh: 前秘書監高斯得亦應詔馳驛上封事，力陳買田之失人心、致天變；

translations.literal: former Secretariat Director Gao Side also responded to the edict, posting by express relay a sealed memorial that forcefully stated how the land purchase had lost the people's hearts and brought heavenly omens;
translations.idiomatic: the former Secretariat Director Gao Side likewise answered the summons, sending a sealed memorial by express relay in which he argued forcefully that the land purchases had alienated the people and provoked heaven's warnings;

sentences.zh: 謝枋得校文江東運司，方山京校文天府，皆指陳得失。

translations.literal: Xie Fangde, examining texts for the Jiangdong transport commission, and Fang Shanqing, examining texts for the National University, both pointed out the gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Fangde, who graded examination papers for the Jiangdong transport commission, and Fang Shanqing, who graded papers for the National University, both set forth the policy's faults and merits.

sentences.zh: 未幾，蕭規等真決黥隸，枋得、山京相繼被劾，斯得雖予郡，尋罷之。

translations.literal: Before long, Xiao Gui and others were truly sentenced to tattooing and convict service; Fangde and Shanqing were impeached in succession; Side was given a prefecture but soon dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Xiao Gui and his fellows were actually sentenced to facial tattooing and penal servitude; Fangde and Shanqing were impeached one after another; and though Side was granted a prefecture, he was soon removed.
